jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 Tether and its affiliated entities (e.g. Bitfinex) are searching for an organized self-starter to join our Regulatory and Licensing team as Head of Licensing and Regulatory Authorisations. The successful candidate is someone with an understanding of the regulatory environment pertaining to the digital-asset industry / stablecoin industry, and who is excited by the opportunity to apply their existing legal and / or regulatory experience in an exciting and dynamic business environment.
 The Head of Licensing and Regulatory Authorisations will lead the development and execution of our global authorisations strategy across key jurisdictions, working through a geographically distributed team of regional regulatory affairs and licensing teams. This role is responsible for securing and maintaining regulatory approvals required for the company’s operations, ensuring alignment with shifting regulatory landscapes, and enabling sustainable market expansion.
 As a senior leader within the Regulatory Affairs & Licensing function, you will collaborate closely with regional licensing personnel, legal, compliance, product, and executive leadership to drive licensing initiatives end-to-end—from early regulatory assessments and submissions through to supervisory engagement and operational readiness. The ideal candidate brings deep multi-jurisdictional licensing expertise, exceptional stakeholder management skills, and the ability to coordinate across regions in a cohesive, consistent manner.
 You will report to the Vice President of the Regulatory Affairs and Licensing division, and work alongside project managers and members of the wider business to execute on regulatory and licensing initiatives.

Responsibilities
 Licensing Strategy & Execution

• Design and implement a unified global licensing strategy, ensuring consistency across regional approaches.

• Work closely with regional licensing personnel to assess regulatory pathways, evaluate market feasibility, and prioritise jurisdictions.

• Oversee and guide the preparation, submission, and management of licensing applications and / or other regulatory authorisation processes, in collaboration with regional teams.

• Ensure alignment between regional licensing efforts and global business priorities.

Regional Coordination & Stakeholder Management

• Serve as the central point of coordination for licensing and regulatory authorisation activity across all regions, ensuring standards, documentation, and approaches remain cohesive.

• Provide direct support, guidance, and escalation oversight to regional licensing personnel.

• Align regulatory authorisation efforts with regulatory affairs leads to coordinate regulatory engagement strategies across regions.

Regulatory Engagement

• Act as a senior representative in regulatory engagements where global coordination or executive-level involvement is required.

• Support regional teams in interactions with local regulators, offering strategic guidance and ensuring consistent messaging.

Operational Readiness & Governance

• Coordinate with regional teams to ensure their understanding around local regulatory requirements such that they are prepared to meet jurisdictional authorisation obligations, where needed and / or desired, including governance, capital, operational, and reporting requirements.

• Maintain global oversight of regulatory authorisation conditions, ensuring local compliance is consistent with global policies and standards.

• Lead responses to cross-regional regulatory queries or supervisory reviews related to authorisation activities.

Market Expansion & Risk Analysis

• Work with regional personnel to conduct regulatory feasibility assessments for new markets and product expansions.

• Provide strategic recommendations to executive leadership on prioritisation of authorisation efforts and regulatory risk.

Team Leadership

• Lead and mentor the global regulatory and licensing team, including regional leads and supporting personnel.

• Build capability, consistency, and knowledge-sharing across regions to strengthen the company’s global licensing and authorisations function.

• Promote a culture of regulatory excellence, transparency, and disciplined execution.

Experience & Expertise

• 10+ years of experience in regulatory licensing and authorisations, regulatory affairs, compliance, or related fields (financial services, payments, fintech, crypto, or technology).

• Proven experience managing complex regulatory authorisation processes across multiple regions or markets.

• Strong understanding of diverse regulatory frameworks and supervisory expectations globally.

• Experience working within or leading a regional or matrixed team structure is highly preferred.

Skills & Competencies

• Exceptional cross-regional coordination and stakeholder engagement skills.

• Strong project management capabilities and ability to manage complex, multi-jurisdictional workstreams.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, able to synthesise regional inputs into a coherent global strategy.

• Strategic thinker with strong execution discipline.

• Ability to build trust and credibility with regulators and internal leadership.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

• Serve as the central point of coordination for licensing and regulatory authorisation activity across all regions, ensuring standards, documentation, and approaches remain cohesive.

• Act as a senior representative in regulatory engagements where global coordination or executive-level involvement is required.

• Coordinate with regional teams to ensure their understanding around local regulatory requirements such that they are prepared to meet jurisdictional authorisation obligations, where needed and / or desired, including governance, capital, operational, and reporting requirements.

jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 Tether is seeking an experienced and visionary Head of Regulatory Affairs to design and execute global regulatory affairs strategies for our Tether Data business vertical. At Tether Data, we are committed to pioneering advancements in AI and peer-to-peer (P2P) technologies. Our mission is to innovate and lead in the creation of technological solutions that empower people, communities, cities and countries to become more independent and sovereign. In a world constantly changing and becoming more unpredictable, technology should be used to ensure freedom and respect of human rights, rather than capturing people’s private digital lives.

Responsibilities

• Policy Advocacy, Monitoring, Analysis and Guidance : Monitor, analyse and communicate changes in global regulatory policies, and advise executive leadership on potential regulatory risks and opportunities, while driving initiatives to influence regulatory frameworks as well as monitoring for change across regulations to ensure proactive compliance where required.

• Regulatory Advocacy and Thought Leadership : Leading or participating in regulatory agency interactions and advocacy work regarding legislation relevant to this field. Engaging with relevant regulatory authorities, industry bodies, collaborative communities, and policymakers to shape the regulatory landscape for AI and P2P.

• Regulatory Strategy Development : As appropriate, leading the development and execution of regulatory strategies, identifying preferable market/s from which to operate, and to ensure the company’s readiness for compliance with relevant national and international regulations.

• Cross-functional Leadership and Product Development : Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., R&D, legal, compliance) in both Tether and with our partners to to integrate regulatory considerations into the design and deployment of AI models and technologies, as applicable.

• Thought Leadership: Act as a thought leader both externally and within the organization, educating internal teams on regulatory issues, trends, and best practices in the AI and P2P space.

• Proven experience in a senior regulatory role, ideally within the technology, AI, or digital industries.

• Strong knowledge of global AI regulations, data privacy laws (e.g., GDPR), and emerging trends in AI and P2P governance. Legal, compliance, or policy background with a deep understanding of ethical AI principles is a plus.

• Demonstrated understanding of decentralised, self-sovereign and locally executed AI/P2P architectures—and the regulatory implications of these models—distinct from traditional centralised platform approaches.

• Demonstrated experience working with regulators and government bodies advocating and advising in a regulatory capacity, with demonstrated achievements securing favourable policy positions on behalf of another organisation.

• Expertise in preparing complex regulatory documents and other major regulatory submissions, including the preparation and execution of interactions with regulatory authorities.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law, Policy, Computer Science, or related fields.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesise complex regulatory topics for non-technical audiences.

• Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders across borders and time zones.

• Communication: Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with experience in public speaking and representing companies in regulatory discussions.

• Must be a strong team player, and willing to be fully engaged with key stakeholders both in our company but also with our partners. Must be a hands-on professional capable of working collaboratively and independently.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 Tether and its affiliated entities (e.g. Bitfinex) are searching for an organized self-starter to join our Regulatory and Licensing team. The successful candidate is someone with a deep understanding of legal and regulatory requirements pertaining to the crypto-asset industry in Argentina, and who is excited by the opportunity to apply their existing regulatory experience in an exciting and dynamic business environment.
 The successful candidate will report directly to the Head of Regulatory Affairs & Licensing – Latin America, serving as the primary point of contact for regulatory and licensing matters within Argentina. This is a senior position designed for professionals with proven experience engaging with or working within financial regulators, supervisory authorities, or policy-making bodies. The ideal candidate combines strategic insight with hands-on execution, demonstrates a diplomatic, solutions-oriented approach in navigating complex regulatory environments, and is able to anticipate regulatory changes and adapt strategies proactively to evolving market and legal environments. You will represent the company in regulatory discussions, contribute to regional initiatives under the guidance of the Head of Regulatory Affairs & Licensing – Latin America, and ensure local implementation aligns with the company’s broader Latin American regulatory objectives.
 To succeed in this role, the incumbent will continuously strive to self-develop and enhance their skill sets including understanding the Company’s products and services, blockchain technology, crypto-assets and the regulatory requirements. Engage with industry associations, chambers, and other stakeholder groups to promote innovation and collaboration.

You will have a focus around translating regulatory requirements in Argentina into clear and actionable strategic recommendations, managing relationships and communications between various stakeholders both internal and external to the business.

Responsibilities

• Regulatory Strategy Development: development and execution of regulatory strategies, identifying preferable market/s in the region from which to operate. Ensure local implementation aligns with Tether’s broader Latin American regulatory objectives.

• Regulatory Advocacy and Collaboration : participating in regulatory agency interactions, engaging with relevant regulatory authorities, industry bodies, and policymakers to shape the regulatory landscape for stablecoin issuers, advocating for policies that promote innovation while ensuring safety and compliance. Actively contribute to public consultations, working groups, and industry forums, maintaining a high standard of professionalism and institutional diplomacy.

• Policy Analysis and Guidance : Provide analysis on local regulatory proposals, and advise the business on potential regulatory risks and opportunities, while driving initiatives to influence regulatory frameworks as well as monitoring for change across regulations to ensure proactive compliance. Produce concise internal policy briefs and recommendations to inform senior management decision-making.

• Regulatory approval process : contribute to the process of obtaining necessary license approvals in identified markets, where appropriate. Support the preparation and coordination of documentation and responses to regulatory inquiries, ensuring strategic consistency and accuracy.

• Cross-functional Leadership : Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., expansion, legal, compliance, finance) to ensure alignment with regulatory requirements and to proactively address emerging regulatory challenges. Serve as the local regulatory lead, ensuring effective communication and alignment with regional priorities.

• Minimum of 5 years regulatory experience within the financial services or crypto-asset industry.

• Preferred: Minimum of 5–8 years regulatory experience within financial services, fintech, or crypto-asset industries.

• Ability to apply knowledge of key regulatory frameworks in Argentina both strategically and operationally and provide direction to resolve complex regulatory issues.

• Demonstrated diplomatic skills and ability to manage complex stakeholder relationships.

• Expertise in preparing regulatory analysis including the preparation and execution of interactions with regulatory authorities, such as regulatory consultation response submissions.

• Proven experience working with or within regulatory authorities (e.g., central banks, financial supervisory agencies, or ministries of finance) is strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated ability to draft or contribute to public policy responses, regulatory filings, or industry position papers.

• Communication: Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with experience in public speaking and representing companies in regulatory discussions.

• Must be a strong team player, and willing to be fully engaged with key stakeholders both in our company but also with our partners. Must have hands-on professional capable of working collaboratively and independently, with excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Fluency in English and native proficiency in the local language of Argentina.

• University degree.

• Advanced degree in Law, Economics, Political Science, or a related field preferred.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

The primary goal of a Developer Relations is to engage, educate, and inspire the developer community - building trust, driving adoption of our technology, and ensuring developers have an exceptional experience with our products. This involves creating technical content, presenting at events, gathering feedback, and serving as the voice of the developer both externally and internally.

The role is focused on bridging the gap between developers and our product teams, ensuring our solutions are accessible, well-understood, and developer-friendly, while fostering community growth, promoting best practices, and driving continuous improvement in how developers discover, learn, and build with our technology.

QVAC is a cutting-edge development platform designed for building privacy-focused AI applications. Unlike traditional AI tools that rely heavily on cloud-based infrastructure, QVAC is designed to run entirely on local devices, giving users full control over their data.

Responsibilities
 Developer Advocacy & Community Building

• Build and nurture relationships with developers, partners, and open-source communities.

• Engage and interact with the developer ecosystem — hosting AMAs, office hours, webinars, and play a part in online communities.

• Collect and synthesize developer feedback to inform product and engineering teams.

• Identify influential developers, projects, and communities to establish collaboration opportunities.

Technical Content & Enablement

• Create and maintain high-quality technical content (blog posts, tutorials, sample apps, videos, documentation, SDK guides, etc.) directly targeted to developers.

• Develop demos, prototypes, and reference implementations that showcase real-world use cases.

• Contribute to improving developer experience through documentation feedback, onboarding flows, and API design suggestions.

• Support developer onboarding through workshops, hackathons, and training sessions.

Product Evangelism

• Advocate for the company’s technology stack at industry events, developer meetups, and online communities.

• Translate complex technical concepts into clear, relatable value propositions.

• Collaborate with marketing to align technical storytelling with broader brand messaging.

• Track and report community sentiment and adoption metrics to measure evangelism impact.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner closely with engineering, product management, and marketing to align developer needs with product strategy.

• Provide structured feedback loops between external developers and internal teams to improve product usability.

• Support launch strategies for new developer-facing features, APIs, and SDKs.

• Contribute to roadmap discussions to ensure developer experience remains a strategic priority.

• Support initial technical discussions with potential customers and partners

Thought Leadership

• Represent the company as a credible technical voice in the ecosystem through public speaking, open-source contributions, and community engagement.

• Stay ahead of industry trends, tools, and frameworks relevant to the developer community.

• Mentor internal teams on effective developer communication and community engagement practices.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field - or equivalent professional experience.

• 3+ years of professional software development experience.

• Previous experience as a Developer Advocate, Developer Relations, or Technical Community Manager.

• Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js - able to write production-level code and explain it clearly to other developers.

• Demonstrated experience building, testing, and maintaining applications or APIs.

• Proven ability to create technical content (tutorials, sample projects, blog posts, videos, or documentation) that educates and inspires developers.

• Experience presenting at public events, such as developer conferences, meetups, webinars, or internal company talks.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into simple, engaging messages.

• Experience engaging with developer communities through events, GitHub, forums, or social media.

• Strong understanding of developer experience principles and best practices.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with product, engineering, and marketing teams.

• Strong experience with Llama.cpp and ggml inference engines, which facilitates the deployment of models to specific GPU architectures

• Experience with AI or ML technologies, such as building or integrating LLMs, chatbots, or AI-driven SDKs and APIs.

• English fluency — outstanding written and verbal communication skills are required for public-facing content and developer engagement.

Preferred

• Experience designing, documenting, or promoting SDKs or developer tools.

• Experience developing or integrating apps (web, mobile, or desktop).

• 4–6 years of experience in software development or developer relations.

• Experience leveraging AI tools (such as Cursor, Codex, or similar AI-assisted development workflows) to enhance productivity and problem-solving efficiency

• Contributions to open-source projects or maintaining public GitHub repositories.

• Understanding of DevRel success metrics - content reach, community engagement, and product adoption.

• Experience in technical writing, developer education, or public speaking.

• Passion for community building, mentoring, and empowering developers through content and collaboration.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.it: Unisciti a Tether e Forma il Futuro della Finanza Digitale A Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i gettoni di riserva in blockchains. Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione. Innovare con Tether Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin, USDT , basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, oltre a servizi di tokenizzazione digitale di asset. Ma questo è solo l'inizio: Tether Power: Guidare la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano l'eccesso di potenza per l'estrazione mineraria di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche eco-friendly in strutture geo-diverse all'avanguardia. Tether Data: Riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET , la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione dei dati sicura e privata. Tether Education: Democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, forniamo agli individui di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, guidando la crescita globale e l'opportunità. Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, realizzando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti. Perché unirsi a noi? Il nostro team è una potenza di talento globale, lavorando da remoto da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti veloci, siamo stati magra, e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore. Se avete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese e siete pronti a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto per voi. Sei pronto a far parte del futuro? L'obiettivo primario di una relazione di sviluppo è quello di coinvolgere, educare, e ispirare la comunità di sviluppatori - costruire la fiducia, guidare l'adozione della nostra tecnologia, e garantire agli sviluppatori un'esperienza eccezionale con i nostri prodotti. Ciò comporta la creazione di contenuti tecnici, presentando eventi, raccogliendo feedback e servendo come voce dello sviluppatore sia esternamente che internamente. Il ruolo è focalizzato sul colmare il divario tra gli sviluppatori e i nostri team di prodotti, assicurando che le nostre soluzioni siano accessibili, ben comprese e amichevoli per gli sviluppatori, promuovendo la crescita della comunità, promuovendo le migliori pratiche e promuovendo un miglioramento continuo nel modo in cui gli sviluppatori scoprono, imparano e costruiscono con la nostra tecnologia. QVAC è una piattaforma di sviluppo all'avanguardia progettata per la costruzione di applicazioni AI focalizzate sulla privacy. A differenza dei tradizionali strumenti AI che si basano fortemente sull'infrastruttura basata su cloud, QVAC è progettato per funzionare interamente su dispositivi locali, dando agli utenti il pieno controllo sui loro dati. Responsabilità Sviluppatore Advocacy & Community Building Build e allevare le relazioni con sviluppatori, partner e comunità open source. Coinvolgere e interagire con l'ecosistema sviluppatore — ospitando AMA, ore di ufficio, webinar, e partecipare a comunità online. Raccogliere e sintetizzare il feedback degli sviluppatori per informare i team di prodotto e di ingegneria. Identificare sviluppatori, progetti e comunità influenti per stabilire opportunità di collaborazione. Creare e mantenere contenuti tecnici di alta qualità (blog post, tutorial, app campione, video, documentazione, guide SDK, ecc.) direttamente mirati agli sviluppatori. Sviluppa demo, prototipi e implementazioni di riferimento che mostrano casi di utilizzo nel mondo reale. Contribuisci a migliorare l'esperienza degli sviluppatori attraverso il feedback della documentazione, i flussi di bordo e i suggerimenti di progettazione API. Supporto sviluppatore a bordo attraverso workshop, hackathons e sessioni di formazione. Prodotto Evangelismo Avvocato per lo stack di tecnologia dell'azienda in eventi di settore, incontri di sviluppatori e comunità online. Traduci concetti tecnici complessi in proposte di valore chiare e relatable. Collabora con il marketing per allineare la narrazione tecnica con la messaggistica di marca più ampia. Traccia e segnala le metriche del sentimento e dell'adozione della comunità per misurare l'impatto evangelistico. Collaborazione Cross-Functional Partner strettamente con l'ingegneria, la gestione dei prodotti e il marketing per allineare le esigenze degli sviluppatori con la strategia di prodotto. Fornire loop di feedback strutturati tra sviluppatori esterni e team interni per migliorare l'usabilità del prodotto. Supporta le strategie di lancio per nuove funzionalità, API e SDK. Contribuire alle discussioni sulla roadmap per garantire che l'esperienza degli sviluppatori rimanga una priorità strategica. Sostenere le prime discussioni tecniche con potenziali clienti e partner Thought Leadership Rappresentare l'azienda come una voce tecnica credibile nell'ecosistema attraverso i contributi pubblici, open source e l'impegno comunitario. Rimanete al passo con le tendenze, gli strumenti e le strutture del settore rilevanti per la comunità degli sviluppatori. Squadre interne Mentor su efficaci pratiche di comunicazione dello sviluppatore e di impegno della comunità. Laurea in Informatica, ingegneria del software, o campo relativo - o equivalente esperienza professionale. 3+ anni di esperienza di sviluppo software professionale. Esperienza precedente come Sviluppatore Avvocato, Rapporti Sviluppatori, o Technical Community Manager. Forte esperienza pratica con JavaScript, TypeScript e Node.js - in grado di scrivere codice di livello di produzione e spiegarlo chiaramente ad altri sviluppatori. descriptionByLocale.en:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job The primary goal of a Developer Relations is to engage, educate, and inspire the developer community - building trust, driving adoption of our technology, and ensuring developers have an exceptional experience with our products. This involves creating technical content, presenting at events, gathering feedback, and serving as the voice of the developer both externally and internally. The role is focused on bridging the gap between developers and our product teams, ensuring our solutions are accessible, well-understood, and developer-friendly, while fostering community growth, promoting best practices, and driving continuous improvement in how developers discover, learn, and build with our technology. QVAC is a cutting-edge development platform designed for building privacy-focused AI applications. Unlike traditional AI tools that rely heavily on cloud-based infrastructure, QVAC is designed to run entirely on local devices, giving users full control over their data. Responsibilities Developer Advocacy & Community Building
• Build and nurture relationships with developers, partners, and open-source communities.
• Engage and interact with the developer ecosystem — hosting AMAs, office hours, webinars, and play a part in online communities.
• Collect and synthesize developer feedback to inform product and engineering teams.
• Identify influential developers, projects, and communities to establish collaboration opportunities. Technical Content & Enablement
• Create and maintain high-quality technical content (blog posts, tutorials, sample apps, videos, documentation, SDK guides, etc.) directly targeted to developers.
• Develop demos, prototypes, and reference implementations that showcase real-world use cases.
• Contribute to improving developer experience through documentation feedback, onboarding flows, and API design suggestions.
• Support developer onboarding through workshops, hackathons, and training sessions. Product Evangelism
• Advocate for the company’s technology stack at industry events, developer meetups, and online communities.
• Translate complex technical concepts into clear, relatable value propositions.
• Collaborate with marketing to align technical storytelling with broader brand messaging.
• Track and report community sentiment and adoption metrics to measure evangelism impact. Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Partner closely with engineering, product management, and marketing to align developer needs with product strategy.
• Provide structured feedback loops between external developers and internal teams to improve product usability.
• Support launch strategies for new developer-facing features, APIs, and SDKs.
• Contribute to roadmap discussions to ensure developer experience remains a strategic priority.
• Support initial technical discussions with potential customers and partners Thought Leadership
• Represent the company as a credible technical voice in the ecosystem through public speaking, open-source contributions, and community engagement.
• Stay ahead of industry trends, tools, and frameworks relevant to the developer community.
• Mentor internal teams on effective developer communication and community engagement practices.
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field - or equivalent professional experience.
• 3+ years of professional software development experience.
• Previous experience as a Developer Advocate, Developer Relations, or Technical Community Manager.
• Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js - able to write production-level code and explain it clearly to other developers.
• Demonstrated experience building, testing, and maintaining applications or APIs.
• Proven ability to create technical content (tutorials, sample projects, blog posts, videos, or documentation) that educates and inspires developers.
• Experience presenting at public events, such as developer conferences, meetups, webinars, or internal company talks.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into simple, engaging messages.
• Experience engaging with developer communities through events, GitHub, forums, or social media.
• Strong understanding of developer experience principles and best practices.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with product, engineering, and marketing teams.
• Strong experience with Llama.cpp and ggml inference engines, which facilitates the deployment of models to specific GPU architectures
• Experience with AI or ML technologies, such as building or integrating LLMs, chatbots, or AI-driven SDKs and APIs.
• English fluency — outstanding written and verbal communication skills are required for public-facing content and developer engagement. Preferred
• Experience designing, documenting, or promoting SDKs or developer tools.
• Experience developing or integrating apps (web, mobile, or desktop).
• 4–6 years of experience in software development or developer relations.
• Experience leveraging AI tools (such as Cursor, Codex, or similar AI-assisted development workflows) to enhance productivity and problem-solving efficiency
• Contributions to open-source projects or maintaining public GitHub repositories.
• Understanding of DevRel success metrics - content reach, community engagement, and product adoption.
• Experience in technical writing, developer education, or public speaking.
• Passion for community building, mentoring, and empowering developers through content and collaboration. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.fr: Rejoignez Tether et façonnez l'avenir de la finance numérique Chez Tether, nous ne nous contentons pas de créer des produits, nous sommes les pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises (des bourses et portefeuilles aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques) d'intégrer de manière transparente les jetons adossés à des réserves dans les blockchains. En exploitant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, en toute sécurité et à l'échelle mondiale, le tout pour une fraction du coût. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, garantissant la confiance dans chaque transaction. Innovez avec Tether Tether Finance : notre suite de produits innovants comprend le stablecoin le plus fiable au monde, l'USDT, sur lequel s'appuient des centaines de millions de personnes dans le monde, ainsi que des services pionniers de tokenisation d'actifs numériques. Mais ce n’est qu’un début : Tether Power : favorisant une croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l’énergie excédentaire pour l’extraction de Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques respectueuses de l’environnement dans des installations de pointe et géodiverses. Tether Data : En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie peer-to-peer, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET, notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé. Tether Education : en démocratisant l'accès à un apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous permettons aux individus de s'épanouir dans l'économie numérique et des petits boulots, stimulant ainsi la croissance et les opportunités mondiales. Tether Evolution : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, en créant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Notre équipe est une centrale mondiale de talents, travaillant à distance depuis tous les coins du monde. Si vous souhaitez vous démarquer dans le domaine de la fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les limites et d'établir de nouvelles normes. Nous avons connu une croissance rapide, sommes restés minces et avons assuré notre place de leader du secteur. Si vous possédez d'excellentes compétences en communication en anglais et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est fait pour vous. Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ? À propos du poste L'objectif principal d'un développeur de relations est d'engager, d'éduquer et d'inspirer la communauté des développeurs - en instaurant la confiance, en favorisant l'adoption de notre technologie et en garantissant aux développeurs une expérience exceptionnelle avec nos produits. Cela implique de créer du contenu technique, de présenter lors d'événements, de recueillir des commentaires et de servir de voix au développeur à la fois en externe et en interne. Le rôle vise à combler le fossé entre les développeurs et nos équipes de produits, en garantissant que nos solutions sont accessibles, bien comprises et conviviales pour les développeurs, tout en favorisant la croissance de la communauté, en promouvant les meilleures pratiques et en favorisant l'amélioration continue de la façon dont les développeurs découvrent, apprennent et construisent avec notre technologie. QVAC est une plateforme de développement de pointe conçue pour créer des applications d'IA axées sur la confidentialité. Contrairement aux outils d'IA traditionnels qui s'appuient fortement sur une infrastructure basée sur le cloud, QVAC est conçu pour fonctionner entièrement sur des appareils locaux, offrant ainsi aux utilisateurs un contrôle total sur leurs données. Responsabilités Plaidoyer des développeurs et renforcement de la communauté Établir et entretenir des relations avec les développeurs, les partenaires et les communautés open source. Engagez-vous et interagissez avec l'écosystème des développeurs en organisant des AMA, des heures de bureau, des webinaires et jouez un rôle dans les communautés en ligne. Recueillir et synthétiser les commentaires des développeurs pour informer les équipes produit et d'ingénierie. Identifiez les développeurs, les projets et les communautés influents pour établir des opportunités de collaboration. Contenu technique et activation Créez et maintenez un contenu technique de haute qualité (articles de blog, didacticiels, exemples d'applications, vidéos, documentation, guides SDK, etc.) directement destiné aux développeurs. Développez des démos, des prototypes et des implémentations de référence qui présentent des cas d'utilisation réels. Contribuez à améliorer l'expérience des développeurs grâce aux commentaires sur la documentation, aux flux d'intégration et aux suggestions de conception d'API. Soutenez l’intégration des développeurs via des ateliers, des hackathons et des sessions de formation. Évangélisation des produits Défendre la pile technologique de l'entreprise lors d'événements de l'industrie, de rencontres de développeurs et de communautés en ligne. Traduisez des concepts techniques complexes en propositions de valeur claires et pertinentes. Collaborez avec le marketing pour aligner la narration technique sur le message plus large de la marque. Suivez et rapportez les sentiments de la communauté et les mesures d’adoption pour mesurer l’impact de l’évangélisation. Collaboration interfonctionnelle Collaboration étroite avec l'ingénierie, la gestion des produits et le marketing pour aligner les besoins des développeurs sur la stratégie produit. Fournissez des boucles de rétroaction structurées entre les développeurs externes et les équipes internes pour améliorer la convivialité du produit. Prise en charge des stratégies de lancement pour les nouvelles fonctionnalités, API et SDK destinés aux développeurs. Contribuer aux discussions sur la feuille de route pour garantir que l’expérience des développeurs reste une priorité stratégique. Soutenir les discussions techniques initiales avec des clients et partenaires potentiels. Leadership éclairé Représenter l'entreprise en tant que voix technique crédible dans l'écosystème par le biais de prises de parole en public, de contributions open source et d'engagement communautaire. Gardez une longueur d'avance sur les tendances, les outils et les cadres du secteur pertinents pour la communauté des développeurs. Encadrer les équipes internes sur les pratiques efficaces de communication des développeurs et d’engagement communautaire. Baccalauréat en informatique, en génie logiciel ou dans un domaine connexe - ou expérience professionnelle équivalente. Plus de 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle en développement de logiciels. Expérience antérieure en tant que Developer Advocate, Developer Relations ou Technical Community Manager. Solide expérience pratique avec JavaScript, TypeScript et Node.js - capable d'écrire du code au niveau de la production et de l'expliquer clairement aux autres développeurs. Expérience démontrée dans la création, le test et la maintenance d'applications ou d'API. Capacité avérée à créer du contenu technique (tutoriels, exemples de projets, articles de blog, vidéos ou documentation) qui éduque et inspire les développeurs. Expérience de présentation lors d'événements publics, tels que des conférences de développeurs, des rencontres, des webinaires ou des discussions internes à l'entreprise. Excellentes compétences en communication et en présentation, tant écrites qu'orales, avec la capacité de traduire des concepts techniques complexes en messages simples et engageants. Expérience de l'engagement avec les communautés de développeurs via des événements, GitHub, des forums ou des réseaux sociaux. Solide compréhension des principes et des meilleures pratiques en matière d'expérience des développeurs. Capacité à collaborer efficacement avec les équipes de produits, d’ingénierie et de marketing. Solide expérience avec les moteurs d'inférence Llama.cpp et ggml, qui facilitent le déploiement de modèles sur des architectures GPU spécifiques. Expérience avec les technologies d'IA ou de ML, telles que la création ou l'intégration de LLM, de chatbots ou de SDK et d'API basés sur l'IA. Maîtrise de l'anglais – des compétences exceptionnelles en communication écrite et verbale sont requises pour le contenu destiné au public et l'engagement des développeurs. Expérience préférée dans la conception, la documentation ou la promotion de SDK ou d'outils de développement. Expérience dans le développement ou l'intégration d'applications (Web, mobile ou ordinateur de bureau). 4 à 6 ans d'expérience dans le développement de logiciels ou les relations avec les développeurs. Expérience dans l'exploitation d'outils d'IA (tels que Cursor, Codex ou des flux de travail de développement similaires assistés par IA) pour améliorer la productivité et l'efficacité de la résolution de problèmes. Contributions à des projets open source ou maintenance de référentiels publics GitHub. Compréhension des indicateurs de réussite de DevRel : portée du contenu, engagement de la communauté et adoption du produit. Expérience en rédaction technique, en formation des développeurs ou en prise de parole en public. Passion pour la création de communautés, le mentorat et l'autonomisation des développeurs grâce au contenu et à la collaboration. Informations importantes pour les candidats Les escroqueries au recrutement sont devenues de plus en plus courantes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder les points suivants à l'esprit lorsque vous postulez à des postes : postulez uniquement via nos canaux officiels. Nous n'utilisons pas de plateformes ou d'agences tierces pour le recrutement, sauf indication contraire. Tous les postes ouverts sont répertoriés sur notre page officielle des carrières : https://tether.recruitee.com/ Vérifiez l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont des profils LinkedIn vérifiés. En cas de doute, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en nous contactant via notre site Web. Méfiez-vous des méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne menons pas d'entretiens via WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toutes les communications se font via les e-mails et les plateformes officielles de l'entreprise. Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toutes les communications de notre part proviendront d'e-mails se terminant par @ tether.to ou @ tether.io. Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si quelqu’un demande des informations financières personnelles ou un paiement à tout moment du processus d’embauche, il s’agit d’une arnaque. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement. En cas de doute, n'hésitez pas à nous contacter via notre site officiel.

jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 The goal of a Product Manager is to bridge the gap between technical capabilities and business objectives, focusing on the technical aspects of product development. They work closely with engineering teams to define product roadmaps, prioritize features based on market research and customer needs, and ensure the successful delivery of technical products and services. In doing so, they manage the product vision, identify and mitigate potential risks, and maintain alignment with overall business requirements.

About the challenge
 In this role, you will lead the vision, strategy, and execution of a GPU-accelerated cloud services platform designed to empower data scientists, developers, and enterprises to build, train, and deploy AI/ML models at scale — while supporting the growth of the P2P AI ecosystem.
 We’re seeking an experienced Technical Product Manager with a strong bias for action and measurable outcomes — someone who combines deep expertise in AI/ML technologies, cloud infrastructure, and product management with the drive to establish market leadership across strategic verticals.
 This is a great opportunity for an experienced product leader:

• with a strong product-led growth mindset who wants to take their career to the next level, and move from contributing to a product area to having full ownership over the building, scaling and success of an entire new product and service lines

• with experience in the field of AI / ML that goes beyond consumer level and into the core of how modern AI systems behave

• who understands the intricacies of software and hardware to the extent that he/she can actively engage with highly-technical stakeholders

• a team leader who has had close contact with operations and feels capable to work with people in all facets of a product

• a high-agency individual who can actively set internal and external goals, team culture and liaise effectively and directly with executive management and other departments to achieve them

Optionally, would be good to have crossed paths with crypto before, either as a user or professional, and can demonstrate a decent understanding of its mechanics

Responsibilities

• Product Vision & Strategy: Define and champion the long-term vision for a Cloud Services Platform (CSP) across IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS models. Align product direction with company objectives and industry trends to maintain a competitive edge and deliver sustained value.

• Ownership and Leadership: Own and manage a comprehensive product roadmap, prioritizing features and enhancements that drive impact. Collaborate closely with engineering and cross-functional teams to ensure successful delivery of products and services. Build strong relationships with executives, partners, and industry influencers to foster strategic alliances and advocate for the platform’s growth.

• Customer-Centric Focus: Engage directly with engineers, data scientists, and researchers to identify niche market opportunities, maximize value delivery, and ensure seamless product experiences that resonate with technical users.

• Ecosystem Expansion: Partner with other Tether teams to design and scale a centralized, privacy-preserving, and resilient infrastructure layer for P2P networks - strengthening the broader P2P ecosystem.

• Go-To-Market Strategy: Independently develop and execute launch plans in coordination with marketing and expansion teams. Drive positioning, messaging, and market-entry strategies that establish the platform as a key player in select AI/ML CSP niches.

• Performance Tracking: Define and monitor KPIs for product engagement, customer satisfaction, and platform performance to ensure continuous optimization and alignment with success metrics.

• B2B Orientation: Collaborate with enterprise customers to distinguish between users and decision-makers, ensuring that both receive tailored value propositions and measurable business outcomes.

• 7+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years as a technical product manager for AI infrastructure products that include:

• Building or managing AI platform services involving model training, fine-tuning, inference optimization and quantization workflows

• Direct experience with GPU resource management and ML framework infrastructure (beyond API consumption of foundation models)

• Experience interacting with cloud platform services, such as AWS, Azure or GCP across their multiple offerings

• Familiarity with AI-specific cloud platform services, such as TogetherAI, ScaleAI, Databricks or AWS SageMaker, at least from a consumer standpoint and strong understanding of underlying technologies

• Demonstrated understanding of ML model architectures, training dynamics, and optimization techniques

• Past experience in high-growth organizations

• Proven track-record of successful product launches

• Exceptional leadership, communication, prioritization and team-building skills

• Ability to engage and evangelize a product vision to both highly-technical and non-technical stakeholders alike

• Degree in engineering, physical sciences or closely related fields

• Skilled in defining, tracking, and reporting on product KPIs to measure success

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job The role involves working in a dynamic environment with a diverse team of senior backend developers, product managers and leadership to build crypto wallet solutions . The applications are meant to be high performance, light-weight and highly intuitive to cater to a variety of audiences. You will be working on developing cutting edge mobile applications integrating crypto wallets and defi features. Responsibilities
• Development: Design and build advanced and secure cross platform applications for the [iOS/Android] platform using React Native. Collaborate with UI/UX designers to ensure applications are visually appealing and intuitive.
• Integration: Work closely with backend developers and integrate Javascript SDKs, libraries, and backend services into mobile applications.
• Collaboration: Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other developers to deliver innovative solutions. Mandatory
• 3+ years of experience with React , React-Native (mainly around Expo) , Redux and the core principles surrounding these.
• Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+ .
• Experience with CI/CD pipelines for mobile development .
• Familiar with modern front-end pipelines and tools .
• Experienced with Native modules (C++) , WebSockets, RESTful based APIs .
• Experience in Swift/Objective-C (iOS) or Kotlin/Java (Android) for low level implementation. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer (100% remote Worldwide)
jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 As a senior Backend Developer, you will be a part of the team that works on the development and maintenance of the backend components of multiple services related to the platform. This includes:

• New Products and Features - Tether continuously strives to create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional experience for customers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies, to ensure the user experience remains the best in the industry.

• Scalability - all backend services that power Tether platform must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth.

• Security - Tether makes Security its most important feature. The Backend Development team is responsible for building all the API services and backend processes with the highest security principles and standard, in order to protect the safety of the entire user base.

Responsibilities

• Work closely with developers, product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to translate requirements into clear, practical architectures.

• Improve existing core backend services written in NodeJS

• Implement new solutions that interact with different core services through RPC calls

• Write complex database queries for compliance and financial purposes

• At least 5 years of experience working with Javascript/Nodejs.

• Familiar with microservices architecture

• Have actively participated in the development of a complex platform

• Good experience in interacting with databases (MySQL, MongoDB)

• Ability to quickly learn new technologies

• Good understanding of security practices

Preferred skills :

• Experience with blockchain integration

• Comfortable with high-availability concepts

• Ruby and Rails experience

• Other technologies of interest: Message queues (Redis), Caches and Job Queues

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
