Tether Data : En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie peer-to-peer, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET, notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé. Tether Education : en démocratisant l'accès à un apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous permettons aux individus de s'épanouir dans l'économie numérique et des petits boulots, stimulant ainsi la croissance et les opportunités mondiales. Tether Evolution : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, en créant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Notre équipe est une centrale mondiale de talents, travaillant à distance depuis tous les coins du monde. Si vous souhaitez vous démarquer dans le domaine de la fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les limites et d'établir de nouvelles normes. Nous avons connu une croissance rapide, sommes restés minces et avons assuré notre place de leader du secteur. Si vous possédez d'excellentes compétences en communication en anglais et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est fait pour vous. Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ? À propos du poste En tant que membre de notre équipe de recherche en IA, vous stimulerez l'innovation en matière de compression de modèles et de déploiement efficace de systèmes d'IA multimodaux avancés, notamment les grands modèles de langage (LLM) et les modèles de langage de vision (VLM). Votre travail se concentrera sur la réduction de l'empreinte du modèle et des coûts de calcul tout en préservant la précision, permettant à l'IA hautes performances de fonctionner efficacement sur des appareils périphériques aux ressources limitées. Vous appliquerez et progresserez des techniques de compression telles que la quantification, la distillation des connaissances et l'élagage pour rationaliser les architectures multimodales complexes qui intègrent du texte, des images et de l'audio. Nous attendons de vous une expertise approfondie des méthodes de compression de modèles et une solide expérience en architectures de modèles multimodaux. Vous adopterez une approche pratique et axée sur la recherche pour développer, tester et mettre en œuvre de nouvelles stratégies de compression qui équilibrent la taille, la latence, le débit et la précision du modèle. Vos responsabilités incluent la création de pipelines de compression robustes, l'établissement de mesures de performances et de fidélité et la résolution des goulots d'étranglement dans l'inférence de production. L’objectif ultime est de fournir des systèmes d’IA évolutifs, à faible mémoire et à faible latence sur des appareils de pointe (c’est-à-dire les smartphones) qui maintiennent une haute fidélité et une valeur réelle tangible. Responsabilités Décomposez les principales responsabilités en puces. Il est utile de les rendre exploitables et mesurables. Cela pourrait également être regroupé en catégories pour des rôles plus complexes.
• Appliquez une quantification à faible bit pour réduire la taille du modèle et la latence d'inférence pour les modèles d'IA génératifs (LLM, VLM, multimodaux) tout en conservant la précision et la qualité de sortie.
• Tirer parti de la distillation des connaissances pour transférer les capacités des modèles d'enseignants plus grands vers des modèles d'étudiants plus petits, permettant ainsi un raisonnement multimodal efficace à travers les entrées de texte, d'image et audio.
• Implémentez des techniques d'élagage pour supprimer les paramètres redondants et les points d'attention, réduisant ainsi la charge de calcul sans sacrifier les performances des tâches.
• Analyser les compromis entre l'efficacité du modèle (taille, latence, mémoire) et la précision des méthodes de quantification, de distillation et d'élagage ; proposer des améliorations basées sur des résultats empiriques.
• Rechercher et appliquer une quantification à précision mixte et d'autres stratégies de compression avancées (par exemple, programmes d'élagage adaptatifs, distillation avec correspondance de caractéristiques intermédiaires) pour optimiser l'équilibre précision-performance.
• Restez au courant des dernières recherches en matière de compression de modèles, y compris les techniques émergentes pour les architectures multimodales et génératives.
• Documenter clairement les méthodologies, les expériences et les résultats pour soutenir la reproductibilité, la collaboration interne et la communication avec les parties prenantes.
• Rédiger des articles techniques et publier les résultats dans des conférences de premier plan (par exemple, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ACL, AAAI) pour faire progresser le domaine de la compression de modèles pour l'IA multimodale. Énumérez les qualifications, les certifications et l’expérience nécessaires pour le poste. Vous pouvez diviser cela en sections obligatoires et préférées si nécessaire.
• Un diplôme en informatique ou dans un domaine connexe. Idéalement doctorat en PNL, en apprentissage automatique ou dans un domaine connexe, complété par une solide expérience en R&D en IA (avec de bonnes publications dans des conférences A*).
• Expérience avec les cadres d'apprentissage profond PyTorch ou des cadres équivalents.
• Expérience pratique avec la quantification de modèles, y compris la formation basée sur la quantification (QAT) et la quantification post-formation (PTQ).
• Recherche et expérience pratique en matière de distillation des connaissances pour compresser de grands modèles en modèles plus petits et efficaces.
• Recherche et expérience pratique en matière d'élagage de modèles pour compresser de grands modèles en modèles plus petits et efficaces.
• Solide compréhension des architectures de réseaux neuronaux et des processus de formation - Y compris les transformateurs (par exemple, LLM, VLM), les techniques de rétropropagation, d'optimisation et de réglage fin.
• Une connaissance du C++ est un plus (notamment pour implémenter des noyaux de quantification de bas niveau ou des optimisations d'inférence). jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 As a member of our AI model team, you will drive innovation in model serving and inference architectures for advanced AI systems. Your work will focus on optimizing model deployment and inference strategies to deliver highly responsive, efficient, and scalable performance across real-world applications. You will work on a wide spectrum of systems, ranging from resource-efficient models designed for limited hardware environments to complex, multi-modal architectures that integrate data such as text, images, and audio.
 We expect you to have deep expertise in designing and optimizing model serving pipelines and inference frameworks as well as a strong background in advanced model architectures. You will adopt a hands-on, research-driven approach to develop, test, and implement novel serving strategies and inference algorithms. Your responsibilities include engineering robust inference pipelines, establishing comprehensive performance metrics, and identifying and resolving bottlenecks in production environments. The ultimate goal is to enable high-throughput, low-latency, low-memory footprint, and scalable AI performance that delivers tangible value in dynamic, real-world scenarios.

Responsibilities

• Design and deploy state-of-the-art model serving architectures that deliver high throughput and low latency while optimizing memory usage. Ensure these pipelines run efficiently across diverse environments, including resource-constrained devices and edge platforms. Establish clear performance targets such as reduced latency, improved token response, and minimized memory footprint.

• Build, run, and monitor controlled inference tests in both simulated and live production environments. Track key performance indicators such as response latency, throughput, memory consumption, and error rates, with special attention to metrics specific to resource-constrained devices. Document iterative results and compare outcomes against established benchmarks to validate performance across platforms.

• Identify and prepare high-quality test datasets and simulation scenarios tailored to real-world deployment challenges, specifically those encountered on low-resource devices. Set measurable criteria to ensure that these resources effectively evaluate model performance, latency, and memory utilization under various operational conditions.

• Analyze computational efficiency and diagnose bottlenecks in the serving pipeline by monitoring both processing and memory metrics. Address issues such as suboptimal batch processing, network delays, and high memory usage to optimize the serving infrastructure for scalability and reliability on resource-constrained systems.

• Work closely with cross-functional teams to integrate optimized serving and inference frameworks into production pipelines designed for edge and on-device applications. Define clear success metrics such as improved real-world performance, low error rates, robust scalability, optimal memory usage and ensure continuous monitoring and iterative refinements for sustained improvements.

• A degree in Computer Science or related field. Ideally PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D (with good publications in A* conferences).

• Must have knowledge of Metal Shading Language (MSL). You should be comfortable writing custom compute shaders from scratch.

• Proven experience in low-level kernel optimizations and inference optimization on mobile devices is essential. Your contributions should have led to measurable improvements in inference latency, throughput, and memory footprint for domain-specific applications, particularly on resource-constrained devices and edge platforms.

• A deep understanding of modern model serving architectures and inference optimization techniques is required. This includes state-of-the-art methods for achieving low-latency, high-throughput performance, and efficient memory management in diverse, resource-constrained deployment scenarios.

• Must have strong expertise in writing GPU kernels for mobile devices (i.e., smartphones) as well as a deep understanding of model serving frameworks and engines. Practical experience in developing and deploying end-to-end inference pipelines, from optimizing models for efficient serving to integrating these solutions on resource-constrained devices is required.

• Demonstrated ability to apply empirical research to overcome challenges in model serving, such as latency optimization, computational bottlenecks, and memory constraints. You should be proficient in designing robust evaluation frameworks and iterating on optimization strategies to continuously push the boundaries of inference performance and system efficiency.

• Distributed Inference Systems: Designing and optimizing high-performance inference engines using techniques like Tensor Parallelism, Pipeline Parallelism, and Expert Parallelism to handle massive models on GPU clusters.

• Deep understanding of the math and structure behind Diffusion Models and Vision Transformers

• Understanding of Pruning, Quantization, Flash attention, KV Cache, Speculative Decoding (Eagle) etc.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Your work will focus on optimizing model deployment and inference strategies to deliver highly responsive, efficient, and scalable performance across real-world applications. You will work on a wide spectrum of systems, ranging from resource-efficient models designed for limited hardware environments to complex, multi-modal architectures that integrate data such as text, images, and audio. We expect you to have deep expertise in designing and optimizing model serving pipelines and inference frameworks as well as a strong background in advanced model architectures. You will adopt a hands-on, research-driven approach to develop, test, and implement novel serving strategies and inference algorithms. Your responsibilities include engineering robust inference pipelines, establishing comprehensive performance metrics, and identifying and resolving bottlenecks in production environments. • Design and deploy state-of-the-art model serving architectures that deliver high throughput and low latency while optimizing memory usage. Ensure these pipelines run efficiently across diverse environments, including resource-constrained devices and edge platforms. Establish clear performance targets such as reduced latency, improved token response, and minimized memory footprint.
• Build, run, and monitor controlled inference tests in both simulated and live production environments. Track key performance indicators such as response latency, throughput, memory consumption, and error rates, with special attention to metrics specific to resource-constrained devices. Document iterative results and compare outcomes against established benchmarks to validate performance across platforms.
• Identify and prepare high-quality test datasets and simulation scenarios tailored to real-world deployment challenges, specifically those encountered on low-resource devices. • Proven experience in low-level kernel optimizations and inference optimization on mobile devices is essential. Your contributions should have led to measurable improvements in inference latency, throughput, and memory footprint for domain-specific applications, particularly on resource-constrained devices and edge platforms.
• A deep understanding of modern model serving architectures and inference optimization techniques is required. This includes state-of-the-art methods for achieving low-latency, high-throughput performance, and efficient memory management in diverse, resource-constrained deployment scenarios.
• Must have strong expertise in writing GPU kernels for mobile devices (i.e., smartphones) as well as a deep understanding of model serving frameworks and engines. Practical experience in developing and deploying end-to-end inference pipelines, from optimizing models for efficient serving to integrating these solutions on resource-constrained devices is required.

You should be proficient in designing robust evaluation frameworks and iterating on optimization strategies to continuously push the boundaries of inference performance and system efficiency.

 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 The primary goal of a Developer Relations is to engage, educate, and inspire the developer community - building trust, driving adoption of our technology, and ensuring developers have an exceptional experience with our products. This involves creating technical content, presenting at events, gathering feedback, and serving as the voice of the developer both externally and internally.
 The role is focused on bridging the gap between developers and our product teams, ensuring our solutions are accessible, well-understood, and developer-friendly, while fostering community growth, promoting best practices, and driving continuous improvement in how developers discover, learn, and build with our technology.
 Pear is a combined Peer-to-Peer (P2P) Runtime, Development & Deployment tool. Pear makes it possible to build, share and extend P2P applications using common Web and Mobile technology. Herein is everything needed to create unstoppable, zero-infrastructure P2P applications for Desktop, Terminal & Mobile.

Responsibilities
 Developer Advocacy & Community Building

• Build and nurture relationships with developers, partners, and open-source communities.

• Engage and interact with the developer ecosystem — hosting AMAs, office hours, webinars, and play a part in online communities.

• Collect and synthesize developer feedback to inform product and engineering teams.

• Identify influential developers, projects, and communities to establish collaboration opportunities.

Technical Content & Enablement

• Create and maintain high-quality technical content (blog posts, tutorials, sample apps, videos, documentation, SDK guides, etc.) directly targeted to developers.

• Develop demos, prototypes, and reference implementations that showcase real-world use cases.

• Contribute to improving developer experience through documentation feedback, onboarding flows, and API design suggestions.

• Support developer onboarding through workshops, hackathons, and training sessions.

Product Evangelism

• Advocate for the company’s technology stack at industry events, developer meetups, and online communities.

• Translate complex technical concepts into clear, relatable value propositions.

• Collaborate with marketing to align technical storytelling with broader brand messaging.

• Track and report community sentiment and adoption metrics to measure evangelism impact.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner closely with engineering, product management, and marketing to align developer needs with product strategy.

• Provide structured feedback loops between external developers and internal teams to improve product usability.

• Support launch strategies for new developer-facing features, APIs, and SDKs.

• Contribute to roadmap discussions to ensure developer experience remains a strategic priority.

• Support initial technical discussions with potential customers and partners

Thought Leadership

• Represent the company as a credible technical voice in the ecosystem through public speaking, open-source contributions, and community engagement.

• Stay ahead of industry trends, tools, and frameworks relevant to the developer community.

• Mentor internal teams on effective developer communication and community engagement practices.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field - or equivalent professional experience.

• 3+ years of professional software development experience.

• Previous experience as a Developer Advocate, Developer Relations, or Technical Community Manager.

• Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js - able to write production-level code and explain it clearly to other developers.

• Demonstrated experience building, testing, and maintaining applications or APIs.

• Proven ability to create technical content (tutorials, sample projects, blog posts, videos, or documentation) that educates and inspires developers.

• Experience presenting at public events, such as developer conferences, meetups, webinars, or internal company talks.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into simple, engaging messages.

• Experience engaging with developer communities through events, GitHub, forums, or social media.

• Strong understanding of developer experience principles and best practices.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with product, engineering, and marketing teams.

• Strong production experience with React Native and/or Electron (shipping apps that real users love)

• Very comfortable with Node.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems

• English fluency — outstanding written and verbal communication skills are required for public-facing content and developer engagement.

Preferred

• Experience designing, documenting, or promoting SDKs or developer tools.

• Experience developing or integrating apps (web, mobile, or desktop).

• 4–6 years of experience in software development or developer relations.

• Experience leveraging AI tools (such as Cursor, Codex, or similar AI-assisted development workflows) to enhance productivity and problem-solving efficiency

• Contributions to open-source projects or maintaining public GitHub repositories.

• Understanding of DevRel success metrics - content reach, community engagement, and product adoption.

• Experience in technical writing, developer education, or public speaking.

• Passion for community building, mentoring, and empowering developers through content and collaboration.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

This is a role for someone who is genuinely obsessed with product. You will own the full lifecycle of a crypto wallet product used at global scale, from writing the first user story to shipping the feature to measuring what it actually did. You will set the roadmap, drive every sprint, and be the person every engineer, designer, and stakeholder looks to when a decision needs to be made.

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.

If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

Key responsibilities:

• Product development and Roadmap: Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation and requirements gathering to delivery and post-launch analysis. Define user stories, acceptance criteria, perform backlog management and workflows for development teams.

• Technical Expertise: Translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable product requirements. Evaluate technical solutions and prioritize features based on technical feasibility, business impact, and customer value.

• Conduct extensive market research, including customer discovery to understand the value proposition of our product.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with developers, designers, and other stakeholders to gather requirements, validate and deliver solutions.

• Quality & Delivery: Ensure product features are delivered on time and meet quality standards; organize testing and feedback loops.

Mandatory:

• 8+ years of product management experience with at least 3 years in a technical product management role.

• Past experience in building or managing crypto wallets with DeFi features.

• Excellent communication skills for bridging technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• A genuine team player who builds trust quickly, communicates with candor, and makes the people around them more effective.

• Bias toward action. You identify what needs to change, build the case, and move without waiting to be asked.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and get engineers, designers, and business stakeholders pulling toward the same outcome at the same time.

• Equally comfortable setting the strategy and rolling up your sleeves to execute it. You do not hand things off and disappear.

• Thrives in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. You do your best work when the stakes are high and the timeline is short.

• Expertise in agile methodologies - Jira, Asana etc.

• Strong understanding of microservices, peer-to-peer systems, javascript.

• Strong organizational skills to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced, remote environment.

• Skilled in defining, tracking, and reporting on product KPIs to measure success; expertise in A/B testing or similar experimentation methods is a plus.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti a Tether e Forma il futuro della finanza digitale A Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i gettoni di riserva in blockchains. Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione. Innovare con Tether Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin al mondo, USDT , basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme ai servizi di tokenizzazione degli asset digitali. Ma questo è solo l’inizio: Tether Power: Guidare la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano il potere in eccesso per l'estrazione mineraria di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche eco-friendly nelle strutture all'avanguardia e geo-diverse. Tether Data: Riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET , la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione dei dati sicura e privata. Tether Education: Democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, forniamo agli individui di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, guidando la crescita globale e l'opportunità. Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, realizzando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti. Perché unirsi a noi? Il nostro team è una centrale di talento globale, che lavora a distanza da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti veloci, siamo stati magra, e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore. Se avete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese e siete pronti a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto per voi. Sei pronto a far parte del futuro? Riguardo al lavoro Questo è un ruolo per qualcuno che è autenticamente ossessionato dal prodotto. Avrete il ciclo di vita completo di un prodotto portafoglio crypto utilizzato a scala globale, dalla scrittura della prima storia utente alla spedizione della funzione per misurare ciò che ha effettivamente fatto. Impostare la roadmap, guidare ogni sprint, e essere la persona ogni ingegnere, progettista e stakeholder guarda a quando una decisione deve essere presa. Sarete anche la persona che cattura ciò che gli altri manca. Il PM che prospera qui legge ogni biglietto, traccia ogni dipendenza, pone la domanda scomoda prima che diventi un incidente di lancio, e mantiene cinque flussi di lavoro che si muovono simultaneamente senza perdere il filo su uno qualsiasi di loro. Se si preferisce un ruolo PM in cui si imposta la strategia e l'esecuzione del delegato, questo non è il giusto in forma. Se vuoi costruire qualcosa che spedisca a utenti reali, sposta i mercati e trasporta le tue impronte dal concetto alla produzione, vogliamo sentire da te. Responsabilità chiave:
• Sviluppo del prodotto e Roadmap: portare il ciclo di vita end-to-end del prodotto dall'ideazione e dai requisiti di raccolta all'analisi di consegna e post-lancio. Definire le storie degli utenti, i criteri di accettazione, eseguire la gestione del backlog e i flussi di lavoro per i team di sviluppo.
• Competenza Tecnica: Tradurre concetti tecnici complessi in requisiti di prodotto chiari e attuabili. Valutare le soluzioni tecniche e privilegiare le caratteristiche basate sulla fattibilità tecnica, impatto aziendale e valore del cliente.
• Condurre una vasta ricerca di mercato, compresa la scoperta del cliente per capire la proposizione di valore del nostro prodotto.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job This is a role for someone who is genuinely obsessed with product. You will own the full lifecycle of a crypto wallet product used at global scale, from writing the first user story to shipping the feature to measuring what it actually did. You will set the roadmap, drive every sprint, and be the person every engineer, designer, and stakeholder looks to when a decision needs to be made. You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them. If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you. Key responsibilities:
• Product development and Roadmap: Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation and requirements gathering to delivery and post-launch analysis. Define user stories, acceptance criteria, perform backlog management and workflows for development teams.
• Technical Expertise: Translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable product requirements. Evaluate technical solutions and prioritize features based on technical feasibility, business impact, and customer value.
• Conduct extensive market research, including customer discovery to understand the value proposition of our product.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with developers, designers, and other stakeholders to gather requirements, validate and deliver solutions.
• Quality & Delivery: Ensure product features are delivered on time and meet quality standards; organize testing and feedback loops. Mandatory:
• 8+ years of product management experience with at least 3 years in a technical product management role.
• Past experience in building or managing crypto wallets with DeFi features.
• Excellent communication skills for bridging technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• A genuine team player who builds trust quickly, communicates with candor, and makes the people around them more effective.
• Bias toward action. You identify what needs to change, build the case, and move without waiting to be asked.
• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and get engineers, designers, and business stakeholders pulling toward the same outcome at the same time.
• Equally comfortable setting the strategy and rolling up your sleeves to execute it. You do not hand things off and disappear.
• Thrives in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. You do your best work when the stakes are high and the timeline is short.
• Expertise in agile methodologies - Jira, Asana etc.
• Strong understanding of microservices, peer-to-peer systems, javascript.
• Strong organizational skills to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced, remote environment.
• Skilled in defining, tracking, and reporting on product KPIs to measure success; expertise in A/B testing or similar experimentation methods is a plus. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Sie besitzen den gesamten Lebenszyklus eines Krypto-Wandet-Produkts, das im globalen Maßstab verwendet wird, vom Schreiben der ersten Benutzergeschichte bis zum Versand der Funktion, um zu messen, was es tatsächlich tat. Die Premiere, die hier lebt, liest jedes Ticket, verfolgt jede Abhängigkeit, fragt die unbequeme Frage, bevor es zu einem Start-Vorfall wird, und hält fünf Workstreams gleichzeitig bewegen, ohne den Faden auf einen von ihnen zu verlieren. Wenn Sie eine PM-Rolle bevorzugen, in der Sie Strategie festlegen und die Ausführung delegieren, ist dies nicht der richtige. Wenn Sie etwas bauen wollen, das wirkliche Nutzer versendet, Märkte bewegt und Ihre Fingerabdrücke von Konzept zu Produktion trägt, wollen wir von Ihnen hören. Hauptverantwortlichkeiten:

Definieren Sie Benutzergeschichten, Akzeptanzkriterien, führen Sie Backlog-Management und Workflows für Entwicklungsteams durch.

• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten zur Überbrückung technischer und nichttechnischer Akteure.

About the job
 We are developing a highly scalable media intelligence platform that processes, analyzes, and structures large volumes of multimedia content across text, image, video, and audio. As a Senior Applied ML Engineer, you will architect and build the core backend systems that power media ingestion, processing workflows, metadata generation, AI-based analysis, semantic search, and retrieval across large media libraries.
 We are looking for a Senior Applied ML Engineer who can design, implement, optimize, and evaluate a production-grade moderation pipeline using open-source models.

This role requires deep backend engineering expertise, strong system design capability, and practical experience integrating AI/ML systems into production workflows. You will work on complex media-processing pipelines, video/audio analysis, OCR, speech-to-text, embedding generation, vector search, multimodal model integrations, and high-throughput asynchronous workloads. You will collaborate closely with engineering leadership to define backend architecture, improve reliability and scalability, and guide other engineers in delivering secure, observable, and high-performance systems.

Responsibilities
 Backend Architecture & System Ownership

• Architect, build, and operate scalable backend services for a media intelligence platform, with a focus on clean, maintainable, and production-ready systems.

• Own critical backend components end to end, from system design and API contracts through implementation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.

• Drive architectural decisions across APIs, processing pipelines, distributed compute, storage, search, observability, cloud infrastructure, and model-serving workflows.

• Design data models and storage patterns for media assets, generated metadata, embeddings, processing jobs, model outputs, search indexes, and audit trails.

• Design high-throughput media ingestion and processing pipelines for large volumes of video, audio, image, and text content.

AI/ML Integration & Model Workflows

• Lead the development and optimization of metadata extraction, content analysis, scene detection, transcription, embedding generation, and multimodal AI inference workflows.

• Integrate and optimize AI/ML services within backend workflows, including model APIs, embedding pipelines, OCR, speech-to-text, scene analysis, multimodal inference, batching, caching, and fallback strategies.

• Collaborate with ML engineers, data scientists, or external model providers to benchmark models, compare quality/latency trade-offs, and safely roll out model upgrades.

Model Serving & Performance Optimization

• Optimize AI/ML inference workflows for latency, throughput, reliability, and cost across both real-time and batch-processing paths.

Education & Experience

• 5-7+ years of backend engineering experience, ideally building scalable distributed systems, media platforms, data pipelines, or high-throughput backend services.

• Hands-on experience creating AI-powered processing pipelines for image, video, audio, or text analysis.

• Practical experience with production model optimization, especially for image, video, embedding, or multimodal models, including batching, caching, quantization, prompt optimization, routing strategies, latency reduction, and cost optimization.

• Experience with HuggingFace transformers ecosystem and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow.

• Preferred Exposure to distributed systems, microservices, asynchronous processing, and event-driven patterns with SQS, Pub/Sub, Kafka, or other queueing/pub-sub systems

• Experience deploying production systems on AWS, GCP, or similar cloud platforms

AI/ML Integration

Transparenz ist die Grundlage unseres Handelns und gewährleistet Vertrauen bei jeder Transaktion. Innovation mit Tether Tether Finance: Unsere innovative Produktsuite umfasst den vertrauenswürdigsten Stablecoin der Welt, USDT, auf den sich Hunderte Millionen Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verlassen, sowie bahnbrechende Dienste zur Tokenisierung digitaler Vermögenswerte. Aber das ist erst der Anfang: - Tether Power: Unsere Energielösungen fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum und optimieren überschüssigen Strom für das Bitcoin-Mining durch umweltfreundliche Praktiken in hochmodernen, geografisch vielfältigen Anlagen. - Tether Data: Wir treiben Durchbrüche in der KI- und Peer-to-Peer-Technologie voran, senken Infrastrukturkosten und verbessern die globale Kommunikation mit modernsten Lösungen wie KEET, unserer Flaggschiff-App, die den sicheren und privaten Datenaustausch neu definiert. - Tether Education: Durch die Demokratisierung des Zugangs zu erstklassigem digitalen Lernen ermöglichen wir Einzelpersonen, in der digitalen Wirtschaft und der Gig-Wirtschaft erfolgreich zu sein und so globales Wachstum und Chancen voranzutreiben. - Tether Evolution: An der Schnittstelle von Technologie und menschlichem Potenzial verschieben wir die Grenzen des Möglichen und gestalten eine Zukunft, in der Innovation und menschliche Fähigkeiten auf kraftvolle, beispiellose Weise verschmelzen. Warum sollten Sie bei uns mitmachen? - Unser Team ist ein globales Talent-Powerhouse, das von überall auf der Welt aus arbeitet. - Wenn es Ihnen am Herzen liegt, sich im Fintech-Bereich einen Namen zu machen, ist dies Ihre Gelegenheit, mit einigen der klügsten Köpfe zusammenzuarbeiten, Grenzen zu überschreiten und neue Standards zu setzen. - Wir sind schnell gewachsen, schlank geblieben und haben uns unseren Platz als Branchenführer gesichert. - Wenn Sie über ausgezeichnete Englischkenntnisse verfügen und bereit sind, einen Beitrag zur innovativsten Plattform der Welt zu leisten, ist Tether der richtige Ort für Sie. - Sind Sie bereit, Teil der Zukunft zu sein? Über den Job Wir entwickeln eine hoch skalierbare Media-Intelligence-Plattform, die große Mengen multimedialer Inhalte in Text, Bild, Video und Audio verarbeitet, analysiert und strukturiert. Als Senior Applied ML Engineer entwerfen und erstellen Sie die zentralen Backend-Systeme, die die Medienaufnahme, Verarbeitungsworkflows, Metadatengenerierung, KI-basierte Analyse, semantische Suche und den Abruf in großen Medienbibliotheken ermöglichen. Wir suchen einen Senior Applied ML Engineer, der eine Moderationspipeline in Produktionsqualität mithilfe von Open-Source-Modellen entwerfen, implementieren, optimieren und evaluieren kann. Mansioni – Entwerfen, erstellen und betreiben Sie skalierbare Backend-Dienste für eine Media-Intelligence-Plattform mit Schwerpunkt auf sauberen, wartbaren und produktionsbereiten Systemen. - Eigene kritische Backend-Komponenten durchgängig, vom Systemdesign und API-Verträgen bis hin zur Implementierung, Bereitstellung, Überwachung und Iteration. - Treffen Sie Architekturentscheidungen über APIs, Verarbeitungspipelines, verteiltes Computing, Speicher, Suche, Beobachtbarkeit, Cloud-Infrastruktur und Modell-Serving-Workflows. - Entwerfen Sie Datenmodelle und Speichermuster für Medienressourcen, generierte Metadaten, Einbettungen, Verarbeitungsaufträge, Modellausgaben, Suchindizes und Prüfpfade. - Entwerfen Sie Medienaufnahme- und Verarbeitungspipelines mit hohem Durchsatz für große Mengen an Video-, Audio-, Bild- und Textinhalten. - Erstellen Sie verteilte, ereignisgesteuerte Workflows für die Medienverarbeitung mithilfe von Warteschlangen und Pub/Sub-Systemen wie SQS, Kafka, Pub/Sub oder gleichwertigen Technologien. - Implementieren Sie zuverlässige asynchrone Verarbeitungsmuster, einschließlich Wiederholungsversuchen, Idempotenz, Warteschlangen für unzustellbare Nachrichten, Gegendruckbehandlung und fehlertolerante Auftragsausführung. - Leiten Sie die Entwicklung und Optimierung von Metadatenextraktion, Inhaltsanalyse, Szenenerkennung, Transkription, Einbettungsgenerierung und multimodalen KI-Inferenz-Workflows. - Integrieren und optimieren Sie KI/ML-Dienste in Backend-Workflows, einschließlich Modell-APIs, Einbettungspipelines, OCR, Speech-to-Text, Szenenanalyse, multimodale Inferenz, Batching, Caching und Fallback-Strategien. - Arbeiten Sie mit ML-Ingenieuren, Datenwissenschaftlern oder externen Modellanbietern zusammen, um Modelle zu vergleichen, Qualität/Latenz-Kompromisse zu vergleichen und Modell-Upgrades sicher einzuführen. - Bereitstellung und Betrieb von Systemen auf AWS, GCP, Azure oder gleichwertigen Cloud-Plattformen, einschließlich Rechen-, Speicher-, Netzwerk-, Warteschlangen-, Modellserver-Infrastruktur- und Überwachungssystemen. - Stellen Sie die Systemzuverlässigkeit durch Protokollierung, Metriken, Nachverfolgung, Warnungen, Dashboards, betriebliche Runbooks und Best Practices für die Reaktion auf Vorfälle sicher. - Arbeiten Sie mit Produkt-, Design-, Daten- und ML-Teams zusammen, um medienreiche, KI-gestützte Produktfunktionen bereitzustellen. - Betreuen Sie junge und mittlere Ingenieure, unterstützen Sie die technische Planung, prüfen Sie Entwürfe und steigern Sie die technische Qualität im gesamten Team. - Beteiligen Sie sich an Codeüberprüfungen, Dokumentation, technischer Planung und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung der technischen Praktiken. - Stellen Sie die Codequalität durch Tests, Peer-Review, klare Dokumentation und wartbare Implementierungsmuster sicher. Voraussetzungen: Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, Ingenieurwesen oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung. - 5–7+ Jahre Erfahrung im Backend-Engineering, idealerweise im Aufbau skalierbarer verteilter Systeme, Medienplattformen, Datenpipelines oder Backend-Dienste mit hohem Durchsatz. - Vorerfahrung im Besitz wichtiger Backend-Module durchgängig, einschließlich Architektur, Implementierung, Bereitstellung, Überwachung und Produktionsbetrieb. - Mehr als 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Integration von KI/ML-Inferenzsystemen in Backend-Workflows, einschließlich Modell-APIs, Einbettungspipelines, OCR, Sprache-zu-Text, Szenenerkennung oder multimodalen Modellausgaben. - Praktische Erfahrung in der Erstellung KI-gestützter Verarbeitungspipelines für die Bild-, Video-, Audio- oder Textanalyse. - Praktische Erfahrung mit der Optimierung von Produktionsmodellen, insbesondere für Bild-, Video-, Einbettungs- oder multimodale Modelle, einschließlich Batching, Caching, Quantisierung, Prompt-Optimierung, Routing-Strategien, Latenzreduzierung und Kostenoptimierung. - Vorkenntnisse mit Vektorsuche, semantischer Suche, Medienabfrage oder Ähnlichkeitsvergleichssystemen werden dringend empfohlen. - Erleben Sie die Betreuung von Ingenieuren, die Leitung technischer Diskussionen und die Einflussnahme auf Architekturentscheidungen in den Bereichen Backend, Infrastruktur und KI/ML-Workflows. Technische Kompetenz – Starkes Fachwissen in Python und/oder Node.js mit tiefem Verständnis für den Aufbau skalierbarer RESTful-APIs und Backend-Architekturen – Erfahrung mit dem HuggingFace-Transformer-Ökosystem und Deep-Learning-Frameworks wie PyTorch und TensorFlow. - Umfangreiche Erfahrung mit SQL/NoSQL-Datenbanken, Schemadesign und Datenmodellierung. - Bevorzugter Umgang mit verteilten Systemen, Microservices, asynchroner Verarbeitung und ereignisgesteuerten Mustern mit SQS, Pub/Sub, Kafka oder anderen Warteschlangen-/Pub-Sub-Systemen. - Erfahrung in der Bereitstellung von Produktionssystemen auf AWS, GCP oder ähnlichen Cloud-Plattformen. Sprache-zu-Text, Bildklassifizierung, Videoanalyse und multimodale Modellintegrationen. - Erleben Sie die Optimierung von Inferenz-Workflows hinsichtlich Latenz, Durchsatz, Zuverlässigkeit und Kosten. - Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit skalierbaren und optimierten Inferenzeinstellungen, einschließlich der Optimierung von Sampling-Parametern, der Verwaltung von Ausgabelängenformaten und der Konfiguration von Verhaltensweisen im Zusammenhang mit Argumenten. - Vertrautheit mit praktischen Modelloptimierungstechniken wie Batching, Caching, Quantisierung, Modelldestillation, prompte Optimierung, Fallback-Routing und gegebenenfalls Verwendung kleinerer Modelle. - Erfahrung im Umgang mit Modellserversystemen wie vLLM, Triton, TGI, SageMaker, Vertex AI oder benutzerdefinierten Inferenzdiensten wird bevorzugt. - Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit LLM- und multimodalen Bewertungs- und Benchmarking-Frameworks sowie domänenspezifischen Benchmarks mit der Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse zu interpretieren und die Modellleistung entsprechend zu optimieren. - Bevorzugtes Verständnis von verteilten Systemen, Skalierungsmustern und Leistungstechnik - Fähigkeit, modulare, wartbare und effiziente Architekturen zu entwerfen - Erfahrung mit API-Versionierung, Modularisierung und dem Entwerfen lang laufender Arbeitsabläufe - Verständnis von Leistungsengpässen und Backend-Mustern mit geringer Latenz
• Cosa offriamo - Die Möglichkeit, in einer schnelllebigen, innovativen Fintech-Umgebung an hochmodernen KI/ML-Systemen zu arbeiten. - Zusammenarbeit mit globalen Talenten und Branchenführern in den Bereichen Blockchain und KI. - Eine Remote-First-Kultur, die Flexibilität, Autonomie und Work-Life-Balance schätzt. - Wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungs- und Leistungspaket. – Die Chance, die Zukunft des digitalen Finanzwesens und der KI-gestützten Medienintelligenz zu gestalten. Wichtige Informationen für Bewerber: Rekrutierungsbetrug kommt immer häufiger vor. Um sich selbst zu schützen, beachten Sie bitte Folgendes, wenn Sie sich auf Stellen bewerben: - Bewerben Sie sich ausschließlich über unsere offiziellen Kanäle. Wir nutzen für die Rekrutierung keine Plattformen oder Agenturen Dritter, sofern dies nicht ausdrücklich angegeben ist. Alle offenen Stellen sind auf unserer offiziellen Karriereseite aufgeführt: https://tether.recruitee.com/ – Überprüfen Sie die Identität des Personalvermittlers. • Profile. Wir führen keine Interviews über WhatsApp, Telegram oder SMS durch. Die gesamte Kommunikation erfolgt über offizielle E-Mails und Plattformen des Unternehmens. - Überprüfen Sie die E-Mail-Adressen noch einmal. Die gesamte Kommunikation von uns erfolgt über E-Mails, die auf @tether.to oder @tether.io enden. Wir werden niemals nach Zahlungs- oder Finanzdaten fragen. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Description Rejoignez Tether et façonnez l'avenir de la finance numérique Chez Tether, nous ne nous contentons pas de créer des produits, nous sommes les pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises (des bourses et portefeuilles aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques) d'intégrer de manière transparente les jetons adossés à des réserves dans les blockchains. En exploitant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, en toute sécurité et à l'échelle mondiale, le tout pour une fraction du coût. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, garantissant la confiance dans chaque transaction. Innovez avec Tether Tether Finance : notre suite de produits innovants comprend le stablecoin le plus fiable au monde, l'USDT, sur lequel s'appuient des centaines de millions de personnes dans le monde, ainsi que des services pionniers de tokenisation d'actifs numériques. Mais ce n'est que le début : - Tether Power : Favorisant une croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l'énergie excédentaire pour l'extraction de Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques respectueuses de l'environnement dans des installations de pointe et géo-diverses. - Tether Data : En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie peer-to-peer, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET, notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé. - Tether Education : en démocratisant l'accès à un apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous permettons aux individus de s'épanouir dans l'économie numérique et des petits boulots, stimulant ainsi la croissance et les opportunités mondiales. - Tether Evolution : à l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, en créant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? - Notre équipe est une centrale mondiale de talents, travaillant à distance depuis tous les coins du monde. - Si vous souhaitez vous démarquer dans le domaine de la fintech, c'est votre opportunité de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, en repoussant les limites et en établissant de nouvelles normes. - Nous avons connu une croissance rapide, sommes restés minces et avons assuré notre place de leader du secteur. - Si vous possédez d'excellentes compétences en communication en anglais et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est fait pour vous. - Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ? À propos du poste Nous développons une plate-forme d'intelligence médiatique hautement évolutive qui traite, analyse et structure de grands volumes de contenu multimédia à travers le texte, l'image, la vidéo et l'audio. En tant qu'ingénieur senior en ML appliqué, vous concevrez et construirez les principaux systèmes backend qui alimentent l'ingestion de médias, les flux de travail de traitement, la génération de métadonnées, l'analyse basée sur l'IA, la recherche sémantique et la récupération dans de grandes bibliothèques multimédias. Nous recherchons un ingénieur senior en ML appliqué capable de concevoir, de mettre en œuvre, d'optimiser et d'évaluer un pipeline de modération de niveau production à l'aide de modèles open source. Mansioni – Construisez, créez et exploitez des services backend évolutifs pour une plate-forme d'intelligence médiatique, en mettant l'accent sur des systèmes propres, maintenables et prêts pour la production. - Posséder les composants back-end critiques de bout en bout, depuis la conception du système et les contrats d'API jusqu'à la mise en œuvre, le déploiement, la surveillance et l'itération. - Pilotez les décisions architecturales concernant les API, les pipelines de traitement, le calcul distribué, le stockage, la recherche, l'observabilité, l'infrastructure cloud et les workflows de diffusion de modèles. - Concevoir des modèles de données et des modèles de stockage pour les ressources multimédias, les métadonnées générées, les intégrations, les tâches de traitement, les sorties de modèles, les index de recherche et les pistes d'audit. - Concevoir des pipelines d'ingestion et de traitement multimédia à haut débit pour de grands volumes de contenu vidéo, audio, image et texte. - Créez des flux de travail distribués et pilotés par événements pour le traitement des médias à l'aide de files d'attente et de systèmes pub/sub tels que SQS, Kafka, Pub/Sub ou des technologies équivalentes. - Implémentez des modèles de traitement asynchrone fiables, notamment les tentatives, l'idempotence, les files d'attente de lettres mortes, la gestion des contre-pressions et l'exécution des tâches tolérantes aux pannes. - Diriger le développement et l'optimisation des flux de travail d'extraction de métadonnées, d'analyse de contenu, de détection de scènes, de transcription, de génération d'intégration et d'inférence multimodale d'IA. - Intégrez et optimisez les services IA/ML dans les flux de travail backend, y compris les API de modèle, l'intégration de pipelines, l'OCR, la synthèse vocale, l'analyse de scène, l'inférence multimodale, le traitement par lots, la mise en cache et les stratégies de repli. - Collaborez avec des ingénieurs ML, des data scientists ou des fournisseurs de modèles externes pour comparer les modèles, comparer les compromis qualité/latence et déployer en toute sécurité les mises à niveau des modèles. - Déployez et exploitez des systèmes sur AWS, GCP, Azure ou des plates-formes cloud équivalentes, y compris le calcul, le stockage, la mise en réseau, les files d'attente, l'infrastructure de service de modèles et les systèmes de surveillance. - Garantir la fiabilité du système grâce à la journalisation, aux métriques, au traçage, aux alertes, aux tableaux de bord, aux runbooks opérationnels et aux meilleures pratiques de réponse aux incidents. - Collaborer avec les équipes produit, conception, données et ML pour fournir des fonctionnalités de produit riches en médias et basées sur l'IA. - Encadrer les ingénieurs juniors et intermédiaires, soutenir la planification technique, réviser les conceptions et améliorer la qualité de l'ingénierie au sein de l'équipe. - Participer aux révisions de code, à la documentation, à la planification technique et à l'amélioration continue des pratiques d'ingénierie. - Garantir la qualité du code grâce à des tests, un examen par les pairs, une documentation claire et des modèles de mise en œuvre maintenables.
• Requisiti - Baccalauréat en informatique, en ingénierie ou expérience pratique équivalente. - 5 à 7+ années d'expérience en ingénierie back-end, idéalement dans la création de systèmes distribués évolutifs, de plates-formes multimédias, de pipelines de données ou de services back-end à haut débit. - Expérience préalable dans la possession des principaux modules backend de bout en bout, y compris les opérations d'architecture, de mise en œuvre, de déploiement, de surveillance et de production. - Plus de 3 ans d'expérience dans l'intégration de systèmes d'inférence IA/ML dans des flux de travail backend, y compris des API de modèle, l'intégration de pipelines, l'OCR, la parole en texte, la détection de scène ou les sorties de modèles multimodaux. - Expérience pratique dans la création de pipelines de traitement basés sur l'IA pour l'analyse d'images, de vidéos, d'audio ou de texte. - Expérience pratique de l'optimisation des modèles de production, en particulier pour les modèles d'image, de vidéo, d'intégration ou multimodaux, y compris le traitement par lots, la mise en cache, la quantification, l'optimisation rapide, les stratégies de routage, la réduction de la latence et l'optimisation des coûts. - Une expérience préalable en matière de recherche vectorielle, de recherche sémantique, de récupération multimédia ou de systèmes de correspondance de similarité est fortement préférée. - Expérience dans le mentorat d'ingénieurs, dans la direction de discussions techniques et dans l'influence des décisions architecturales dans les workflows backend, d'infrastructure et d'IA/ML. Compétence technique - Forte expertise en Python et/ou Node.js avec une compréhension approfondie de la création d'API RESTful et d'architectures backend évolutives - Expérience avec l'écosystème des transformateurs HuggingFace et les cadres d'apprentissage en profondeur tels que PyTorch et TensorFlow. - Solide expérience avec les bases de données SQL/NoSQL, la conception de schémas et la modélisation de données - Exposition privilégiée aux systèmes distribués, aux microservices, au traitement asynchrone et aux modèles pilotés par les événements avec SQS, Pub/Sub, Kafka ou d'autres systèmes de file d'attente/pub-sub - Expérience dans le déploiement de systèmes de production sur AWS, GCP ou des plates-formes cloud similaires - Connaissance des modèles d'infrastructure (calcul, stockage, réseau, observabilité) - Expérience dans l'orchestration de la génération d'intégration, de la détection de scènes, de l'OCR, synthèse vocale, classification d'images, analyse vidéo et intégrations de modèles multimodaux. - Expérience dans l'optimisation des flux de travail d'inférence en termes de latence, de débit, de fiabilité et de coût. - Expérience de travail avec des paramètres d'inférence évolutifs et optimisés, y compris le réglage des paramètres d'échantillonnage, la gestion des formats de longueur de sortie et la configuration des comportements liés au raisonnement. - Familiarité avec les techniques pratiques d'optimisation de modèles telles que le traitement par lots, la mise en cache, la quantification, la distillation de modèles, l'optimisation rapide, le routage de secours et l'utilisation de modèles plus petits, le cas échéant. - Une expérience de travail avec des systèmes de diffusion de modèles tels que vLLM, Triton, TGI, SageMaker, Vertex AI ou des services d'inférence personnalisés est préférable. - Expérience de travail avec des cadres d'évaluation et d'analyse comparative LLM et multimodaux et des références spécifiques à un domaine avec la capacité d'interpréter les résultats et d'optimiser les performances du modèle en conséquence. - Compréhension préférée des systèmes distribués, des modèles de mise à l'échelle et de l'ingénierie des performances - Capacité à concevoir des architectures modulaires, maintenables et efficaces - Expérience en matière de versionnage, de modularisation et de conception d'API de flux de travail à long terme - Compréhension des goulots d'étranglement en matière de performances et des modèles backend à faible latence
• Cosa offriamo - L'opportunité de travailler sur des systèmes IA/ML de pointe dans un environnement fintech innovant et en évolution rapide. - Collaboration avec des talents mondiaux et des leaders de l'industrie de la blockchain et de l'IA. - Une culture du télétravail qui valorise la flexibilité, l'autonomie et l'équilibre travail-vie personnelle. - Rémunération et avantages sociaux compétitifs. - L'opportunité de façonner l'avenir de la finance numérique et de l'intelligence médiatique basée sur l'IA. Informations importantes pour les candidats Les escroqueries au recrutement sont devenues de plus en plus courantes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder les points suivants à l'esprit lorsque vous postulez à des postes : - Postulez uniquement via nos canaux officiels. Nous n'utilisons pas de plateformes ou d'agences tierces pour le recrutement, sauf indication contraire. Tous les postes ouverts sont répertoriés sur notre page officielle des carrières : https://tether.recruitee.com/ - Vérifiez l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont des profils LinkedIn vérifiés. En cas de doute, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en nous contactant via notre site Web. - Méfiez-vous des méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne menons pas d'entretiens par WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toutes les communications se font via les e-mails et les plateformes officielles de l'entreprise. - Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toutes les communications de notre part proviendront d'e-mails se terminant par @tether.to ou @tether.io - Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si quelqu’un demande des informations financières personnelles ou un paiement à tout moment du processus d’embauche, il s’agit d’une arnaque. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement. En cas de doute, n'hésitez pas à nous contacter via notre site officiel.

jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 We are looking for a precision-driven Global Events Financial Controller to serve as the fiscal engine of our Global Events department. In this role, you will be the primary lead for the entire financial lifecycle of our international events—from the first vendor quotation to the final payment and yearly budget reconciliation.

Responsibilities

• Consolidate quotations

• Elaborate budgets, tracking and reports and real-time financial clarity to the Events Team

• Contracts signature process

• Invoicing and payment process

• Multi-currency & multi-company reconciliations

• Post events reports

Requirements

• Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, or Business Administration.

• 5+ years of experience in accounting of Events, Travel, or Hospitality industry.

• Advanced Excel skills (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables) and Power Point.

• Language: Full professional proficiency or Native in English & Spanish. Italian is a plus.

About the job
 The goal of a Senior QA Engineer is to ensure product quality, reliability, and an exceptional user experience through a balanced combination of manual and automated testing. This involves designing and executing comprehensive test cases, performing exploratory and regression testing, identifying and documenting defects, and ensuring issues are properly tracked and resolved.

Senior QA Engineers also develop and maintain scalable automation frameworks, integrating them into continuous integration and delivery pipelines to achieve broad coverage across functional, regression, and performance scenarios. By continuously improving testing efficiency and reducing manual effort, they help accelerate release cycles without compromising quality.

Focused on preventing defects from reaching end users, Senior QA Engineers collaborate closely with development teams to uphold high standards of usability, performance, and reliability, blending the depth of manual validation with the speed and consistency of automation to deliver a seamless and dependable product experience.

Responsibilities

• Design and Execute Test Cases : Create detailed, well-structured test plans and cases based on product requirements and acceptance criteria.

• Conduct Exploratory Testing : Investigate the application beyond scripted cases to identify edge cases, usability issues, and unexpected behavior.

• Identify and Document Defects : Accurately record issues with clear steps to reproduce, expected vs. actual results, and relevant evidence (screenshots, logs).

• Collaborate with Development Teams : Work closely with developers, product managers, and designers to clarify requirements and discuss quality concerns.

• Validate Bug Fixes : Re-test resolved defects to confirm they are fully fixed and do not introduce new issues.

• Design and Develop Automated Test Cases : Build, maintain, and optimize automated test scripts based on product requirements and acceptance criteria.

• Create and Maintain Test Automation Frameworks : Develop scalable, reusable, and maintainable test automation frameworks that support functional, regression, and performance testing.

• Integrate Automation into CI/CD Pipelines : Collaborate with DevOps and development teams to embed automated tests into continuous integration and delivery workflows.

• Execute Automated Functional Testing : Run automated test suites to validate that each feature works as expected and meets quality standards.

• Monitor and Analyze Test Results : Investigate test failures, identify root causes, and work with development teams to resolve defects.

Mandatory

• Education : Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

• Experience:

• 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, including both manual and automation testing.

• Demonstrated experience defining and executing QA strategies for complex software systems.

• 3+ years of experience in JavaScript, Typescript & NodeJS

• 3+ years of experience in test automation design and implementation (e.g., using Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or equivalent).

• 3+ years of experience in native mobile test automation design and implementation (e.g. Appium, Espresso, XCUITest, Detox, AWS Device Farm, BrowserStack App Automate, Firebase Test Lab, Sauce Labs, Kobiton, Robot Framework, BitBar, LambdaTest Mobile, HeadSpin, Fastlane, Tricentis Testim or equivalent)

• Expertise in defining and implementing test plans, automation frameworks, and quality metrics.

• Strong collaborative skills to align testing efforts with Development, DevOps, and Product Management.

• Ability to critically evaluate requirements for quality, ensuring clarity, testability, and completeness.

• Demonstrated ability to identify release risks, escalate concerns, and recommend no-go decisions when quality standards or release criteria are not met.

• Technical Knowledge :

• Strong understanding of QA methodologies, test design techniques, and SDLC/Agile/Scrum practices.

• Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).

• Proven experience integrating automated tests into build and deployment workflows.

• Proficiency in QA and defect tracking tools (e.g., TestPad, Qase, TestRail, Jira, Asana, Confluence).

• Soft Skills :

• Strong communication, and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Strong self-organisational skills and adaptability. Working effectively in agile and fast-paced environments, and adjusting to changing priorities, requirements and delivery timelines.

• Language : Proficiency in English (spoken and written).

Preferred

• Certifications : ISTQB Advanced Level or equivalent QA certification.

• Knowledge of database systems (SQL, NoSQL) and API testing tools (e.g., Postman, Newman, REST Assured).

• Understanding of system architecture and software integration testing.

• Familiarity with performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, k6, Gatling).

• Understanding of cybersecurity principles and secure software testing practices.

• Experience with test data management and environment configuration.

• Knowledge of performance, load, and security testing principles.
