 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 We are seeking a seasoned Real Estate Portfolio Manager to take full ownership of monitoring, managing, and reporting on an approximately $1 billion portfolio of real estate investments. The portfolio spans third-party managed funds, co-investment Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs), and a selective number of directly held assets, with a pronounced focus on commercial real estate — principally hospitality — complemented by selective residential exposure. This is not a transaction origination role. The focus is portfolio oversight, manager accountability, asset performance monitoring, and investment committee support.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. The successful candidate will serve as the primary analytical and operational interface between the Investment Committee and the external ecosystem of fund managers, asset operators, development partners, and advisors. They will be expected to challenge assumptions with rigour, add value through independent judgment, and hold third parties to a standard of performance, transparency, and accountability commensurate with the capital at stake. The successful candidate must be comfortable independently challenging fund managers, operators, consultants, and valuation assumptions — including when views differ from consensus.

Responsibilities
 Portfolio Monitoring & Fund Oversight
 ○ Fund oversight, performance and benchmarking: Act as the primary point ofaccountability for all third-party managed fund relationships. Review monthlyreporting packages and fund’s information with a critical eye — tracking keymetrics, benchmarking performance, identifying emerging risks, and escalating material deviations from plan.

○ Assumption challenging & pipeline review: Actively challenge underwriting assumptions presented by fund managers and operating partners: cap rates, exit yields, rent growth, occupancy assumptions, development timelines and construction budgets. Leverage market data and comparable evidence to validate or challenge key projections and investment decisions.

SPV & Direct Investment Management
 ○ Financial oversight and liquidity monitoring: Review and challenge budgets, liquidity forecasts, cash flow projections and capital requirements prepared by local operating partners and SPV management teams. Monitor cash positions, funding requirements and drawdown schedules, escalating potential liquidity constraints, cost overruns or capital call requirements to the Investment Committee and Treasury as appropriate.

○ Performance monitoring and variance analysis: Perform rigorous monthly andquarterly variance analysis of actual performance vs. budget, producing clear and actionable IC commentary.

Development Project Monitoring
 ○ Project monitoring and Site visits: Conduct structured site visits to active development projects to assess physical progress against approved business plans and timelines. Review and challenge project schedules, milestone achievement, cost-to-complete estimates and delivery risks, producing site visit reports with clear findings, photographic evidence and recommended actions.
 ○ Cost control & risk management: Review project cost reports, construction drawdown requests, and change order logs - challenging unjustified cost escalations and ensuring contingency utilisation is properly documented. Maintain and update a project-level risk register covering planning, construction, market, and operational risks, with clearly assigned mitigants.

Third-Party Relationship Management
 ○ Stakeholder management & governance: Serve as the main day-to-day interface with fund managers, asset managers, property managers, development companies, hotel operators, and advisors. Participate actively in advisory boards, investor committees, representing Tether’s interests and ensuring key outcomes are documented and tracked.
 ○ Reporting standards & manager accountability: Establish and enforce reporting standards, timelines and information requirements across third-party managers and operators. Hold counterparties accountable against agreed budgets, KPIs, timelines and business plans, escalating material concerns where appropriate.
 ○ Board Representation: As required, act as a director, board observer or shareholder representative on portfolio companies, subsidiaries, SPVs and other investment vehicles, fulfilling governance responsibilities and protecting Tether's interests.

IC Reporting & Decision Support
 ○ Portfolio reporting & dashboards: Prepare high-quality IC reports on a monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc basis — covering performance, key developments, risks, and recommended actions. Develop and maintain asset-level and portfolio-level dashboards tracking KPIs (occupancy, RevPAR, GOP, etc.) against business plan targets.
 ○ Forward-looking analysis & investment recommendations: Provide scenario analysis and sensitivity testing around refinancing cliffs, exit timing, and market value movements. Author and support investment memoranda for new commitments and follow-on investments, ensuring the IC has a thoroughly researched, independently verified view before committing capital.

Qualifications:

● Minimum of 8–12 years of progressive experience in real estate investment management, asset management, or a closely adjacent field (fund of funds, real estate private equity, or institutional asset management).
 ● Demonstrable experience managing or overseeing a real estate portfolio of significant scale — ideally in excess of €500M in aggregate value.
 ● Strong track record working with closed-end and/or open-end real estate fund structures, with a solid understanding of fund structures, LPAs, governance frameworks, capital calls, distributions, and GP/LP dynamics.
 ● Experience overseeing SPV structures, directly held investments and third-party operating partners, with a strong understanding of governance, reporting and capital allocation considerations.
 ● Demonstrated ability to oversee and challenge external fund managers, operators, development partners, and advisors, holding counterparties accountable against agreed business plans, budgets, timelines, and performance targets.
 ● Prior exposure to hospitality real estate — whether through hotel asset management, operator negotiations, or hotel-specific investment underwriting — is strongly preferred and will be weighted heavily.
 ● Experience attending and contributing to investment committees, board meetings, or advisory committees.
 ● Academic background: Degree-level education in Finance, Economics, Real Estate, Business Administration, or a related discipline. A professional qualification such as CFA, MRICS, or equivalent is viewed favourably.
 ● Expert-level financial modelling capability: construction and interrogation of cash flow models, DCF valuations, waterfall distribution models.
 ● Ability to read, interpret, and critically assess fund financial statements, NAV calculations, and asset valuations prepared by independent appraisers.
 ● Strong understanding of real estate operating economics, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis, with the ability to critically assess and challenge business plans and operating assumptions.
 ● Experience reviewing and supporting private real estate valuation processes, including interaction with Finance teams, auditors, valuation advisors, and external stakeholders.
 ● Ability to read and navigate key commercial and investment documentation, including LPAs, SPAs, SHAs, financing agreements, development management agreements, and operating contracts, with sufficient commercial judgment to identify key issues and effectively brief counsel.
 ● Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex operational, financial, and valuation matters into concise recommendations and decision-ready materials for senior management and Investment Committee audiences.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti a Tether e dai forma al futuro della finanza digitale In Tether non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare perfettamente token garantiti da riserve attraverso blockchain. Sfruttando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether ti consente di archiviare, inviare e ricevere token digitali in modo istantaneo, sicuro e globale, il tutto a una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è il fondamento di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione. Innova con Tether Tether Finance: la nostra suite di prodotti innovativa comprende la stablecoin più affidabile al mondo, USDT, su cui fanno affidamento centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme a servizi pionieristici di tokenizzazione delle risorse digitali. Ma questo è solo l’inizio: Tether Power: guidando la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano l’energia in eccesso per l’estrazione di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche ecocompatibili in strutture all’avanguardia e geodiversificate. Tether Data: alimentando innovazioni nell'intelligenza artificiale e nella tecnologia peer-to-peer, riduciamo i costi dell'infrastruttura e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET, la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione sicura e privata dei dati. Tether Education: democratizzando l’accesso all’apprendimento digitale di alto livello, consentiamo alle persone di prosperare nelle economie digitali e gig economy, guidando la crescita e le opportunità globali. Tether Evolution: all'intersezione tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, creando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti. Perché unirsi a noi? Il nostro team è una potenza globale di talenti, che lavora in remoto da ogni angolo del mondo. Se la tua passione è lasciare il segno nel settore fintech, questa è la tua occasione per collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo oltre i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti rapidamente, siamo rimasti snelli e ci siamo assicurati il ​​posto di leader nel settore. Se hai eccellenti capacità di comunicazione in inglese e sei pronto a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto che fa per te. Sei pronto a far parte del futuro? Informazioni sul lavoro Cerchiamo un gestore di portafoglio immobiliare esperto che assuma la piena proprietà del monitoraggio, della gestione e del reporting su un portafoglio di investimenti immobiliari di circa 1 miliardo di dollari. Il portafoglio comprende fondi gestiti da terzi, Special Purpose Vehicles (SPV) di coinvestimento e un numero selezionato di asset detenuti direttamente, con una pronunciata attenzione agli immobili commerciali – principalmente strutture ricettive – integrata da un’esposizione residenziale selettiva. Questo non è un ruolo di creazione di transazioni. L'obiettivo è la supervisione del portafoglio, la responsabilità del gestore, il monitoraggio della performance degli asset e il supporto del comitato di investimento. Questo è un ruolo ad alta proprietà e ad alta visibilità. Il candidato prescelto fungerà da principale interfaccia analitica e operativa tra il Comitato per gli investimenti e l'ecosistema esterno di gestori di fondi, operatori patrimoniali, partner di sviluppo e consulenti. Dovranno sfidare le ipotesi con rigore, aggiungere valore attraverso un giudizio indipendente e imporre ai terzi uno standard di performance, trasparenza e responsabilità commisurato al capitale in gioco. Il candidato prescelto deve sentirsi a proprio agio nel sfidare in modo indipendente gestori di fondi, operatori, consulenti e ipotesi di valutazione, anche quando le opinioni divergono dal consenso. Responsabilità Monitoraggio del portafoglio e supervisione dei fondi ○ Supervisione, performance e benchmarking dei fondi: agire come punto di responsabilità principale per tutti i rapporti con i fondi gestiti da terze parti. Esamina i pacchetti di reporting mensile e le informazioni sui fondi con occhio critico, monitorando i parametri chiave, confrontando le prestazioni, identificando i rischi emergenti e aumentando le deviazioni sostanziali dal piano. ○ Messa in discussione delle ipotesi e revisione della pipeline: sfida attivamente le ipotesi di sottoscrizione presentate dai gestori di fondi e dai partner operativi: tassi massimi, rendimenti di uscita, crescita degli affitti, ipotesi di occupazione, tempistiche di sviluppo e budget di costruzione. Sfrutta i dati di mercato e le prove comparabili per convalidare o contestare proiezioni chiave e decisioni di investimento. SPV e gestione degli investimenti diretti ○ Supervisione finanziaria e monitoraggio della liquidità: revisione e verifica dei budget, previsioni di liquidità, proiezioni dei flussi di cassa e requisiti di capitale preparati dai partner operativi locali e dai team di gestione delle SPV. Monitorare le posizioni di liquidità, i requisiti di finanziamento e i programmi di prelievo, intensificando potenziali vincoli di liquidità, superamenti dei costi o requisiti di richiesta di capitale al Comitato per gli investimenti e al Tesoro, a seconda dei casi. ○ Monitoraggio delle prestazioni e analisi degli scostamenti: esegui rigorose analisi mensili e trimestrali degli scostamenti delle prestazioni effettive rispetto al budget, producendo commenti IC chiari e utilizzabili. Monitoraggio del progetto di sviluppo ○ Monitoraggio del progetto e visite in loco: condurre visite strutturate in loco a progetti di sviluppo attivi per valutare i progressi fisici rispetto ai piani aziendali e alle tempistiche approvati. Esaminare e mettere alla prova le pianificazioni del progetto, il raggiungimento degli obiettivi intermedi, le stime dei costi per il completamento e i rischi di consegna, producendo rapporti sulle visite in loco con risultati chiari, prove fotografiche e azioni consigliate. ○ Controllo dei costi e gestione del rischio: esamina i resoconti sui costi del progetto, le richieste di prelievo di costruzione e i registri degli ordini di modifica, contrastando l'aumento dei costi ingiustificato e garantendo che l'utilizzo di emergenza sia adeguatamente documentato. Mantenere e aggiornare un registro dei rischi a livello di progetto che copra i rischi di pianificazione, costruzione, mercato e operativi, con attenuanti chiaramente assegnati. Gestione delle relazioni con terze parti ○ Gestione e governance delle parti interessate: fungere da principale interfaccia quotidiana con gestori di fondi, gestori patrimoniali, gestori immobiliari, società di sviluppo, operatori alberghieri e consulenti. Partecipare attivamente a comitati consultivi e comitati di investitori, rappresentando gli interessi di Tether e garantendo che i risultati chiave siano documentati e monitorati. ○ Standard di reporting e responsabilità del manager: stabilire e applicare standard di reporting, tempistiche e requisiti di informazione tra manager e operatori di terze parti. Ritenere le controparti responsabili rispetto ai budget concordati, ai KPI, alle tempistiche e ai piani aziendali, intensificando le preoccupazioni materiali ove appropriato. ○ Rappresentanza nel consiglio di amministrazione: se necessario, agire in qualità di amministratore, osservatore del consiglio di amministrazione o rappresentante degli azionisti in società in portafoglio, filiali, società veicolo e altri veicoli di investimento, adempiendo alle responsabilità di governance e proteggendo gli interessi di Tether. Reporting IC e supporto decisionale ○ Reporting e dashboard del portafoglio: prepara report IC di alta qualità su base mensile, trimestrale e ad hoc, coprendo prestazioni, sviluppi chiave, rischi e azioni consigliate. Sviluppa e mantieni dashboard a livello di asset e di portafoglio che monitorano i KPI (occupazione, RevPAR, GOP, ecc.) rispetto agli obiettivi del piano aziendale. ○ Analisi lungimiranti e raccomandazioni di investimento: fornire analisi di scenario e test di sensibilità sui precipizi di rifinanziamento, sui tempi di uscita e sui movimenti del valore di mercato. Redigere e supportare memorandum di investimento per nuovi impegni e investimenti successivi, assicurando che l'IC abbia una visione approfondita e verificata in modo indipendente prima di impegnare capitale. Qualifiche: ● Un minimo di 8–12 anni di esperienza progressiva nella gestione degli investimenti immobiliari, nella gestione patrimoniale o in un campo strettamente adiacente (fondi di fondi, private equity immobiliare o gestione patrimoniale istituzionale). ● Esperienza dimostrabile nella gestione o supervisione di un portafoglio immobiliare di dimensioni significative, idealmente superiore a 500 milioni di euro di valore aggregato. ● Forte esperienza di lavoro con strutture di fondi immobiliari chiusi e/o aperti, con una solida conoscenza delle strutture dei fondi, degli LPA, dei quadri di governance, delle richieste di capitale, delle distribuzioni e delle dinamiche GP/LP. ● Esperienza nella supervisione di strutture SPV, investimenti detenuti direttamente e partner operativi di terze parti, con una profonda conoscenza delle considerazioni di governance, reporting e allocazione del capitale. ● Dimostrata capacità di supervisionare e sfidare gestori di fondi esterni, operatori, partner di sviluppo e consulenti, ritenendo le controparti responsabili rispetto ai piani aziendali, ai budget, alle tempistiche e agli obiettivi di prestazione concordati. ● Una precedente esposizione al settore immobiliare dell'ospitalità, sia attraverso la gestione delle risorse alberghiere, le negoziazioni con gli operatori o la sottoscrizione di investimenti specifici per l'hotel, è fortemente preferita e sarà fortemente ponderata. ● Esperienza nella partecipazione e nel contributo a comitati di investimento, riunioni del consiglio o comitati consultivi. ● Background accademico: istruzione di livello universitario in finanza, economia, settore immobiliare, amministrazione aziendale o una disciplina correlata. Una qualifica professionale come CFA, MRICS o equivalente è vista favorevolmente. ● Capacità di modellazione finanziaria a livello di esperto: costruzione e interrogazione di modelli di flussi di cassa, valutazioni DCF, modelli di distribuzione a cascata. ● Capacità di leggere, interpretare e valutare criticamente i rendiconti finanziari dei fondi, i calcoli del NAV e le valutazioni delle attività preparate da periti indipendenti. ● Ottima conoscenza dell'economia operativa del settore immobiliare, del budget, delle previsioni e dell'analisi degli scostamenti, con la capacità di valutare criticamente e mettere in discussione i piani aziendali e le ipotesi operative. ● Esperienza nella revisione e nel supporto dei processi di valutazione immobiliare privata, inclusa l'interazione con team finanziari, revisori, consulenti di valutazione e parti interessate esterne. ● Capacità di leggere e navigare nella documentazione commerciale e di investimento chiave, inclusi LPA, SPA, SHA, accordi di finanziamento, accordi di gestione dello sviluppo e contratti operativi, con sufficiente giudizio commerciale per identificare le questioni chiave e fornire consulenza efficace. ● Forti capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale, con la capacità di distillare questioni operative, finanziarie e di valutazione complesse in raccomandazioni concise e materiali pronti per prendere decisioni per il senior management e il pubblico del Comitato per gli investimenti. Informazioni importanti per i candidati Le truffe nel reclutamento sono diventate sempre più comuni. Per proteggerti, tieni presente quanto segue quando fai domanda per un ruolo:
• Candidati solo attraverso i nostri canali ufficiali. Non utilizziamo piattaforme o agenzie di terze parti per il reclutamento se non chiaramente indicato. Tutti i ruoli aperti sono elencati sulla nostra pagina ufficiale delle carriere: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verifica l'identità del reclutatore. Tutti i nostri reclutatori hanno profili LinkedIn verificati. Se non sei sicuro, puoi confermare la loro identità controllando il loro profilo o contattandoci tramite il nostro sito web.
• Prestare attenzione ai metodi di comunicazione insoliti. Non conduciamo interviste tramite WhatsApp, Telegram o SMS. Tutte le comunicazioni avvengono tramite e-mail e piattaforme ufficiali dell'azienda.
• Ricontrolla gli indirizzi e-mail. Tutte le nostre comunicazioni arriveranno da e-mail che terminano con @ tether.to o @ tether.io
• Non richiederemo mai pagamenti o dettagli finanziari. Se qualcuno chiede informazioni finanziarie personali o un pagamento in qualsiasi momento durante il processo di assunzione, si tratta di una truffa. Per favore segnalatelo immediatamente. In caso di dubbi, non esitate a contattarci tramite il nostro sito Web ufficiale.

By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We are seeking a seasoned Real Estate Portfolio Manager to take full ownership of monitoring, managing, and reporting on an approximately $1 billion portfolio of real estate investments. The portfolio spans third-party managed funds, co-investment Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs), and a selective number of directly held assets, with a pronounced focus on commercial real estate — principally hospitality — complemented by selective residential exposure. This is not a transaction origination role. The focus is portfolio oversight, manager accountability, asset performance monitoring, and investment committee support. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. The successful candidate will serve as the primary analytical and operational interface between the Investment Committee and the external ecosystem of fund managers, asset operators, development partners, and advisors. They will be expected to challenge assumptions with rigour, add value through independent judgment, and hold third parties to a standard of performance, transparency, and accountability commensurate with the capital at stake. The successful candidate must be comfortable independently challenging fund managers, operators, consultants, and valuation assumptions — including when views differ from consensus. Responsibilities Portfolio Monitoring & Fund Oversight ○ Fund oversight, performance and benchmarking: Act as the primary point ofaccountability for all third-party managed fund relationships. Review monthlyreporting packages and fund’s information with a critical eye — tracking keymetrics, benchmarking performance, identifying emerging risks, and escalating material deviations from plan. ○ Assumption challenging & pipeline review: Actively challenge underwriting assumptions presented by fund managers and operating partners: cap rates, exit yields, rent growth, occupancy assumptions, development timelines and construction budgets. Leverage market data and comparable evidence to validate or challenge key projections and investment decisions. SPV & Direct Investment Management ○ Financial oversight and liquidity monitoring: Review and challenge budgets, liquidity forecasts, cash flow projections and capital requirements prepared by local operating partners and SPV management teams. Monitor cash positions, funding requirements and drawdown schedules, escalating potential liquidity constraints, cost overruns or capital call requirements to the Investment Committee and Treasury as appropriate. ○ Performance monitoring and variance analysis: Perform rigorous monthly andquarterly variance analysis of actual performance vs. budget, producing clear and actionable IC commentary. Development Project Monitoring ○ Project monitoring and Site visits: Conduct structured site visits to active development projects to assess physical progress against approved business plans and timelines. Review and challenge project schedules, milestone achievement, cost-to-complete estimates and delivery risks, producing site visit reports with clear findings, photographic evidence and recommended actions. ○ Cost control & risk management: Review project cost reports, construction drawdown requests, and change order logs - challenging unjustified cost escalations and ensuring contingency utilisation is properly documented. Maintain and update a project-level risk register covering planning, construction, market, and operational risks, with clearly assigned mitigants. Third-Party Relationship Management ○ Stakeholder management & governance: Serve as the main day-to-day interface with fund managers, asset managers, property managers, development companies, hotel operators, and advisors. Participate actively in advisory boards, investor committees, representing Tether’s interests and ensuring key outcomes are documented and tracked. ○ Reporting standards & manager accountability: Establish and enforce reporting standards, timelines and information requirements across third-party managers and operators. Hold counterparties accountable against agreed budgets, KPIs, timelines and business plans, escalating material concerns where appropriate. ○ Board Representation: As required, act as a director, board observer or shareholder representative on portfolio companies, subsidiaries, SPVs and other investment vehicles, fulfilling governance responsibilities and protecting Tether's interests. IC Reporting & Decision Support ○ Portfolio reporting & dashboards: Prepare high-quality IC reports on a monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc basis — covering performance, key developments, risks, and recommended actions. Develop and maintain asset-level and portfolio-level dashboards tracking KPIs (occupancy, RevPAR, GOP, etc.) against business plan targets. ○ Forward-looking analysis & investment recommendations: Provide scenario analysis and sensitivity testing around refinancing cliffs, exit timing, and market value movements. Author and support investment memoranda for new commitments and follow-on investments, ensuring the IC has a thoroughly researched, independently verified view before committing capital. Qualifications: ● Minimum of 8–12 years of progressive experience in real estate investment management, asset management, or a closely adjacent field (fund of funds, real estate private equity, or institutional asset management). ● Demonstrable experience managing or overseeing a real estate portfolio of significant scale — ideally in excess of €500M in aggregate value. ● Strong track record working with closed-end and/or open-end real estate fund structures, with a solid understanding of fund structures, LPAs, governance frameworks, capital calls, distributions, and GP/LP dynamics. ● Experience overseeing SPV structures, directly held investments and third-party operating partners, with a strong understanding of governance, reporting and capital allocation considerations. ● Demonstrated ability to oversee and challenge external fund managers, operators, development partners, and advisors, holding counterparties accountable against agreed business plans, budgets, timelines, and performance targets. ● Prior exposure to hospitality real estate — whether through hotel asset management, operator negotiations, or hotel-specific investment underwriting — is strongly preferred and will be weighted heavily. ● Experience attending and contributing to investment committees, board meetings, or advisory committees. ● Academic background: Degree-level education in Finance, Economics, Real Estate, Business Administration, or a related discipline. A professional qualification such as CFA, MRICS, or equivalent is viewed favourably. ● Expert-level financial modelling capability: construction and interrogation of cash flow models, DCF valuations, waterfall distribution models. ● Ability to read, interpret, and critically assess fund financial statements, NAV calculations, and asset valuations prepared by independent appraisers. ● Strong understanding of real estate operating economics, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis, with the ability to critically assess and challenge business plans and operating assumptions. ● Experience reviewing and supporting private real estate valuation processes, including interaction with Finance teams, auditors, valuation advisors, and external stakeholders. ● Ability to read and navigate key commercial and investment documentation, including LPAs, SPAs, SHAs, financing agreements, development management agreements, and operating contracts, with sufficient commercial judgment to identify key issues and effectively brief counsel. ● Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex operational, financial, and valuation matters into concise recommendations and decision-ready materials for senior management and Investment Committee audiences. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Über die Stelle: Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Immobilien-Portfoliomanager, der die volle Verantwortung für die Überwachung, Verwaltung und Berichterstattung über ein Portfolio von Immobilieninvestitionen im Wert von ca. 1 Milliarde US-Dollar übernimmt. Das Portfolio umfasst von Dritten verwaltete Fonds, Co-Investment-Spezialvehikel (SPVs) und eine ausgewählte Anzahl direkt gehaltener Vermögenswerte, mit einem ausgeprägten Fokus auf Gewerbeimmobilien – vor allem Gastgewerbe – ergänzt durch selektives Wohnimmobilien-Engagement. Dies ist keine Transaktionserstellungsrolle. Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Portfolioüberwachung, der Verantwortung der Manager, der Überwachung der Vermögensleistung und der Unterstützung des Anlageausschusses. Dies ist eine Rolle mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und hoher Sichtbarkeit. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird als primäre analytische und operative Schnittstelle zwischen dem Investitionsausschuss und dem externen Ökosystem aus Fondsmanagern, Vermögensbetreibern, Entwicklungspartnern und Beratern fungieren. Von ihnen wird erwartet, dass sie Annahmen rigoros hinterfragen, durch unabhängiges Urteil einen Mehrwert schaffen und von Dritten einen Standard an Leistung, Transparenz und Rechenschaftspflicht verlangen, der dem auf dem Spiel stehenden Kapital entspricht. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat muss in der Lage sein, unabhängig Fondsmanager, Betreiber, Berater und Bewertungsannahmen in Frage zu stellen – auch wenn die Ansichten vom Konsens abweichen. Verantwortlichkeiten: Portfolioüberwachung und Fondsüberwachung ○ Fondsüberwachung, Performance und Benchmarking: Als Hauptverantwortungsstelle für alle von Dritten verwalteten Fondsbeziehungen fungieren. Überprüfen Sie die monatlichen Berichtspakete und Fondsinformationen mit kritischem Blick – verfolgen Sie Schlüsselkennzahlen, vergleichen Sie die Leistung, identifizieren Sie aufkommende Risiken und eskalieren Sie wesentliche Abweichungen vom Plan. ○ Hinterfragen von Annahmen und Überprüfung der Pipeline: Hinterfragen Sie aktiv die von Fondsmanagern und Betriebspartnern vorgelegten Underwriting-Annahmen: Kapitalisierungsraten, Ausstiegsrenditen, Mietwachstum, Belegungsannahmen, Entwicklungszeitpläne und Baubudgets. Nutzen Sie Marktdaten und vergleichbare Beweise, um wichtige Prognosen und Investitionsentscheidungen zu bestätigen oder zu hinterfragen. SPV- und Direktinvestitionsmanagement ○ Finanzaufsicht und Liquiditätsüberwachung: Überprüfung und Überprüfung von Budgets, Liquiditätsprognosen, Cashflow-Prognosen und Kapitalanforderungen, die von lokalen Betriebspartnern und SPV-Managementteams erstellt wurden. Überwachen Sie den Bargeldbestand, den Finanzierungsbedarf und die Abrufpläne und eskalieren Sie gegebenenfalls potenzielle Liquiditätsengpässe, Kostenüberschreitungen oder Kapitalabrufanforderungen an den Investitionsausschuss und das Finanzministerium. ○ Leistungsüberwachung und Varianzanalyse: Führen Sie eine strenge monatliche und vierteljährliche Varianzanalyse der tatsächlichen Leistung im Vergleich zum Budget durch und erstellen Sie klare und umsetzbare IC-Kommentare. Überwachung von Entwicklungsprojekten ○ Projektüberwachung und Besuche vor Ort: Führen Sie strukturierte Besuche vor Ort bei aktiven Entwicklungsprojekten durch, um den physischen Fortschritt anhand genehmigter Geschäftspläne und Zeitpläne zu bewerten. Überprüfen und hinterfragen Sie Projektpläne, das Erreichen von Meilensteinen, Schätzungen der Kosten bis zur Fertigstellung und Lieferrisiken und erstellen Sie Besuchsberichte vor Ort mit klaren Ergebnissen, fotografischen Beweisen und empfohlenen Maßnahmen. ○ Kostenkontrolle und Risikomanagement: Überprüfen Sie Projektkostenberichte, Bauabnahmeanträge und Änderungsauftragsprotokolle, um ungerechtfertigten Kostensteigerungen entgegenzuwirken und sicherzustellen, dass die Nutzung von Notfallmaßnahmen ordnungsgemäß dokumentiert wird. Führen und aktualisieren Sie ein Risikoregister auf Projektebene, das Planungs-, Bau-, Markt- und Betriebsrisiken mit klar zugewiesenen Risikominderungsmaßnahmen abdeckt. Third-Party-Relationship-Management ○ Stakeholder-Management und Governance: Dienen als wichtigste tägliche Schnittstelle zu Fondsmanagern, Vermögensverwaltern, Immobilienverwaltern, Entwicklungsunternehmen, Hotelbetreibern und Beratern. Beteiligen Sie sich aktiv an Beiräten und Investorenausschüssen, vertreten Sie die Interessen von Tether und stellen Sie sicher, dass wichtige Ergebnisse dokumentiert und verfolgt werden. ○ Berichtsstandards und Verantwortlichkeit der Manager: Legen Sie Berichtsstandards, Zeitpläne und Informationsanforderungen für Drittmanager und -betreiber fest und setzen Sie diese durch. Machen Sie die Gegenparteien hinsichtlich der vereinbarten Budgets, KPIs, Zeitpläne und Geschäftspläne zur Rechenschaft und eskalieren Sie gegebenenfalls wesentliche Bedenken. ○ Vertretung im Vorstand: Bei Bedarf als Direktor, Beobachter im Vorstand oder Anteilseignervertreter bei Portfoliounternehmen, Tochtergesellschaften, SPVs und anderen Anlagevehikeln fungieren, Governance-Aufgaben wahrnehmen und die Interessen von Tether schützen. IC-Berichte und Entscheidungsunterstützung ○ Portfolio-Berichte und Dashboards: Erstellen Sie monatlich, vierteljährlich und Ad-hoc hochwertige IC-Berichte, die Leistung, wichtige Entwicklungen, Risiken und empfohlene Maßnahmen abdecken. Entwickeln und pflegen Sie Dashboards auf Asset- und Portfolio-Ebene, die KPIs (Belegung, RevPAR, GOP usw.) im Vergleich zu den Zielen des Geschäftsplans verfolgen. ○ Zukunftsgerichtete Analysen und Anlageempfehlungen: Bereitstellung von Szenarioanalysen und Sensitivitätstests in Bezug auf Refinanzierungsklippen, Ausstiegszeitpunkte und Marktwertbewegungen. Verfassen und unterstützen Sie Investitionsmemoranden für neue Verpflichtungen und Folgeinvestitionen und stellen Sie sicher, dass das IC vor der Kapitalzusage über eine gründlich recherchierte, unabhängig überprüfte Meinung verfügt. Qualifikationen: ● Mindestens 8–12 Jahre Erfahrung in der Immobilieninvestitionsverwaltung, Vermögensverwaltung oder einem eng angrenzenden Bereich (Dachfonds, Immobilien-Private Equity oder institutionelle Vermögensverwaltung). ● Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Verwaltung oder Überwachung eines Immobilienportfolios von beträchtlicher Größe – idealerweise mit einem Gesamtwert von mehr als 500 Millionen Euro. ● Starke Erfolgsbilanz bei der Arbeit mit geschlossenen und/oder offenen Immobilienfondsstrukturen, mit einem soliden Verständnis von Fondsstrukturen, LPAs, Governance-Rahmenwerken, Kapitalabrufen, Ausschüttungen und GP/LP-Dynamik. ● Erfahrung in der Überwachung von SPV-Strukturen, direkt gehaltenen Investitionen und externen Betriebspartnern, mit einem ausgeprägten Verständnis für Governance, Berichterstattung und Überlegungen zur Kapitalallokation. ● Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, externe Fondsmanager, Betreiber, Entwicklungspartner und Berater zu überwachen und herauszufordern und Gegenparteien hinsichtlich vereinbarter Geschäftspläne, Budgets, Zeitpläne und Leistungsziele zur Rechenschaft zu ziehen. ● Vorheriges Engagement in Hotelimmobilien – sei es durch Hotel-Asset-Management, Betreiberverhandlungen oder hotelspezifisches Investment-Underwriting – wird stark bevorzugt und stark gewichtet. ● Erfahrung in der Teilnahme und Mitarbeit an Anlageausschüssen, Vorstandssitzungen oder Beratungsausschüssen. ● Akademischer Hintergrund: Hochschulabschluss in den Bereichen Finanzen, Wirtschaft, Immobilien, Betriebswirtschaft oder einer verwandten Disziplin. Eine berufliche Qualifikation wie CFA, MRICS oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation wird positiv bewertet. ● Finanzmodellierungsfunktionen auf Expertenebene: Erstellung und Abfrage von Cashflow-Modellen, DCF-Bewertungen, Wasserfallverteilungsmodellen. ● Fähigkeit, von unabhängigen Gutachtern erstellte Fondsabschlüsse, NAV-Berechnungen und Vermögensbewertungen zu lesen, zu interpretieren und kritisch zu bewerten. ● Ausgeprägtes Verständnis der Betriebsökonomie, Budgetierung, Prognose und Abweichungsanalyse von Immobilien mit der Fähigkeit, Geschäftspläne und Betriebsannahmen kritisch zu bewerten und zu hinterfragen. ● Erfahrung in der Überprüfung und Unterstützung privater Immobilienbewertungsprozesse, einschließlich der Interaktion mit Finanzteams, Wirtschaftsprüfern, Bewertungsberatern und externen Stakeholdern. ● Fähigkeit, wichtige Geschäfts- und Investitionsdokumente, einschließlich LPAs, SPAs, SHAs, Finanzierungsvereinbarungen, Entwicklungsmanagementvereinbarungen und Betriebsverträge, zu lesen und darin zu navigieren, mit ausreichendem kaufmännischem Urteilsvermögen, um wichtige Probleme zu identifizieren und eine effektive Kurzberatung zu ermöglichen. ● Starke schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Betriebs-, Finanz- und Bewertungsfragen in prägnante Empfehlungen und entscheidungsreife Materialien für die Zielgruppen des oberen Managements und des Investitionsausschusses zu bündeln. Wichtige Informationen für Kandidaten: Betrug bei der Personalbeschaffung kommt immer häufiger vor. Um sich selbst zu schützen, beachten Sie bitte Folgendes, wenn Sie sich auf Stellen bewerben:
• Bewerben Sie sich ausschließlich über unsere offiziellen Kanäle. Wir nutzen für die Rekrutierung keine Plattformen oder Agenturen Dritter, sofern dies nicht ausdrücklich angegeben ist. Alle offenen Stellen sind auf unserer offiziellen Karriereseite aufgeführt: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Überprüfen Sie die Identität des Personalvermittlers. Alle unsere Personalvermittler verfügen über verifizierte LinkedIn-Profile. Wenn Sie sich nicht sicher sind, können Sie ihre Identität bestätigen, indem Sie ihr Profil überprüfen oder uns über unsere Website kontaktieren.
• Seien Sie vorsichtig bei ungewöhnlichen Kommunikationsmethoden. Wir führen keine Interviews über WhatsApp, Telegram oder SMS durch. Die gesamte Kommunikation erfolgt über offizielle E-Mails und Plattformen des Unternehmens.
• Überprüfen Sie Ihre E-Mail-Adressen noch einmal. Die gesamte Kommunikation von uns erfolgt über E-Mails, die auf @tether.to oder @tether.io enden.
• Wir werden niemals nach Zahlungs- oder Finanzdaten fragen. Wenn jemand zu irgendeinem Zeitpunkt während des Einstellungsprozesses nach persönlichen Finanzinformationen oder Zahlungen fragt, handelt es sich um Betrug. Bitte melden Sie es umgehend. Im Zweifelsfall können Sie sich gerne über unsere offizielle Website an uns wenden.

Si vous possédez d'excellentes compétences en communication en anglais et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est fait pour vous. À propos du poste Nous recherchons un gestionnaire de portefeuille immobilier chevronné pour assumer l'entière responsabilité de la surveillance, de la gestion et du reporting d'un portefeuille d'investissements immobiliers d'environ 1 milliard de dollars. Le portefeuille comprend des fonds gérés par des tiers, des véhicules de co-investissement (SPV) et un nombre sélectif d'actifs détenus directement, avec un accent prononcé sur l'immobilier commercial – principalement l'hôtellerie – complété par une exposition résidentielle sélective. Il ne s’agit pas d’un rôle d’origination de transaction. L'accent est mis sur la surveillance du portefeuille, la responsabilité des gestionnaires, la surveillance de la performance des actifs et le soutien du comité d'investissement. Il s’agit d’un rôle à forte appropriation et à haute visibilité. Le candidat retenu servira de principale interface analytique et opérationnelle entre le comité d'investissement et l'écosystème externe de gestionnaires de fonds, d'opérateurs d'actifs, de partenaires de développement et de conseillers. Ils devront remettre en question les hypothèses avec rigueur, ajouter de la valeur grâce à un jugement indépendant et obliger les tiers à respecter des normes de performance, de transparence et de responsabilité proportionnées au capital en jeu. Le candidat retenu doit être à l’aise de remettre en question de manière indépendante les gestionnaires de fonds, les opérateurs, les consultants et les hypothèses d’évaluation, y compris lorsque les points de vue diffèrent du consensus. Responsabilités Surveillance du portefeuille et surveillance des fonds ○ Surveillance, performance et analyse comparative des fonds : Agir en tant que principal point de responsabilité pour toutes les relations avec les fonds gérés par des tiers. Examinez les rapports mensuels et les informations du fonds avec un œil critique : suivez les indicateurs clés, comparez les performances, identifiez les risques émergents et signalez les écarts importants par rapport au plan. ○ Remettre en question les hypothèses et examiner le pipeline : contester activement les hypothèses de souscription présentées par les gestionnaires de fonds et les partenaires opérationnels : taux de capitalisation, rendements de sortie, croissance des loyers, hypothèses d'occupation, calendriers de développement et budgets de construction. Tirez parti des données de marché et des preuves comparables pour valider ou contester les projections clés et les décisions d’investissement. SPV et gestion des investissements directs ○ Surveillance financière et suivi des liquidités : examiner et remettre en question les budgets, les prévisions de liquidité, les projections de flux de trésorerie et les exigences en capital préparées par les partenaires opérationnels locaux et les équipes de direction du SPV. Surveiller les positions de trésorerie, les besoins de financement et les calendriers de retrait, en faisant remonter les contraintes de liquidité potentielles, les dépassements de coûts ou les exigences d'appel de capitaux au comité d'investissement et à la trésorerie, le cas échéant. ○ Surveillance des performances et analyse des écarts : effectuez une analyse mensuelle et trimestrielle rigoureuse des écarts entre les performances réelles et le budget, en produisant des commentaires IC clairs et exploitables. Surveillance des projets de développement ○ Surveillance des projets et visites de sites : effectuer des visites de sites structurées sur des projets de développement actifs pour évaluer les progrès physiques par rapport aux plans d'affaires et aux calendriers approuvés. Examiner et remettre en question les calendriers des projets, les étapes franchies, les estimations des coûts de réalisation et les risques de livraison, en produisant des rapports de visite sur site contenant des conclusions claires, des preuves photographiques et des actions recommandées. ○ Contrôle des coûts et gestion des risques : examinez les rapports sur les coûts du projet, les demandes de retrait de construction et les journaux de commandes de modification - en contestant les augmentations de coûts injustifiées et en garantissant que l'utilisation des imprévus est correctement documentée. Tenir et mettre à jour un registre des risques au niveau du projet couvrant les risques de planification, de construction, de marché et opérationnels, avec des mesures d'atténuation clairement assignées. Gestion des relations avec les tiers ○ Gestion et gouvernance des parties prenantes : Servir de principale interface quotidienne avec les gestionnaires de fonds, les gestionnaires d'actifs, les gestionnaires immobiliers, les sociétés de développement, les exploitants d'hôtels et les conseillers. Participer activement aux conseils consultatifs et aux comités d’investisseurs, en représentant les intérêts de Tether et en veillant à ce que les principaux résultats soient documentés et suivis. ○ Normes de reporting et responsabilité des gestionnaires : établir et appliquer des normes de reporting, des délais et des exigences d'information auprès des gestionnaires et opérateurs tiers. Tenir les contreparties responsables des budgets convenus, des KPI, des délais et des plans d'affaires, en faisant remonter les préoccupations importantes le cas échéant. ○ Représentation au conseil d'administration : selon les besoins, agir en tant qu'administrateur, observateur du conseil d'administration ou représentant des actionnaires dans les sociétés du portefeuille, les filiales, les SPV et autres véhicules d'investissement, en assumant les responsabilités de gouvernance et en protégeant les intérêts de Tether. Rapports IC et aide à la décision ○ Rapports et tableaux de bord de portefeuille : préparez des rapports IC de haute qualité sur une base mensuelle, trimestrielle et ponctuelle, couvrant les performances, les développements clés, les risques et les actions recommandées. Développer et maintenir des tableaux de bord au niveau des actifs et du portefeuille qui suivent les KPI (occupation, RevPAR, GOP, etc.) par rapport aux objectifs du plan d'affaires. ○ Analyse prospective et recommandations d'investissement : fournissez une analyse de scénarios et des tests de sensibilité concernant les falaises de refinancement, le calendrier de sortie et les mouvements de la valeur marchande. Rédiger et soutenir des mémorandums d'investissement pour les nouveaux engagements et les investissements de suivi, en garantissant que le CI dispose d'une vision approfondie et vérifiée de manière indépendante avant d'engager du capital. Qualifications : ● Minimum de 8 à 12 années d'expérience progressive dans la gestion d'investissements immobiliers, la gestion d'actifs ou un domaine étroitement adjacent (fonds de fonds, capital-investissement immobilier ou gestion d'actifs institutionnels). ● Expérience démontrable dans la gestion ou la supervision d'un portefeuille immobilier d'une ampleur significative – idéalement supérieur à 500 millions d'euros en valeur globale. ● Solide expérience de travail avec des structures de fonds immobiliers fermés et/ou ouverts, avec une solide compréhension des structures de fonds, des LPA, des cadres de gouvernance, des appels de capitaux, des distributions et de la dynamique GP/LP. ● Expérience dans la supervision de structures SPV, d'investissements détenus directement et de partenaires opérationnels tiers, avec une solide compréhension des considérations de gouvernance, de reporting et d'allocation du capital. ● Capacité démontrée à superviser et à contester les gestionnaires de fonds externes, les opérateurs, les partenaires de développement et les conseillers, en tenant les contreparties responsables des plans d'affaires, des budgets, des délais et des objectifs de performance convenus. ● Une exposition préalable à l'immobilier hôtelier – que ce soit par la gestion d'actifs hôteliers, les négociations avec les opérateurs ou la souscription d'investissements spécifiques à un hôtel – est fortement préférée et sera fortement pondérée. ● Expérience de participation et de contribution à des comités d'investissement, des réunions du conseil d'administration ou des comités consultatifs. ● Formation académique : formation de niveau universitaire en finance, économie, immobilier, administration des affaires ou dans une discipline connexe. Une qualification professionnelle telle que CFA, MRICS ou équivalent est considérée favorablement. ● Capacité de modélisation financière de niveau expert : construction et interrogation de modèles de flux de trésorerie, valorisations DCF, modèles de distribution en cascade. ● Capacité à lire, interpréter et évaluer de manière critique les états financiers des fonds, les calculs de valeur liquidative et les évaluations d'actifs préparés par des évaluateurs indépendants. ● Solide compréhension de l'économie d'exploitation immobilière, de la budgétisation, des prévisions et de l'analyse des écarts, avec la capacité d'évaluer et de remettre en question de manière critique les plans d'affaires et les hypothèses d'exploitation. ● Expérience dans l'examen et le soutien des processus d'évaluation de biens immobiliers privés, y compris l'interaction avec les équipes financières, les auditeurs, les conseillers en évaluation et les parties prenantes externes. ● Capacité à lire et à parcourir les principaux documents commerciaux et d'investissement, y compris les LPA, SPA, SHA, les accords de financement, les accords de gestion du développement et les contrats d'exploitation, avec un jugement commercial suffisant pour identifier les problèmes clés et conseiller efficacement. ● Solides compétences en communication écrite et verbale, avec la capacité de distiller des questions opérationnelles, financières et d'évaluation complexes en recommandations concises et en documents prêts à prendre des décisions destinés à la haute direction et au public du comité d'investissement. Informations importantes pour les candidats Les escroqueries au recrutement sont devenues de plus en plus courantes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder les points suivants à l'esprit lorsque vous postulez à des postes :
• Postulez uniquement via nos canaux officiels. Nous n'utilisons pas de plateformes ou d'agences tierces pour le recrutement, sauf indication contraire. Tous les postes ouverts sont répertoriés sur notre page officielle des carrières : https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Vérifiez l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont des profils LinkedIn vérifiés. En cas de doute, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en nous contactant via notre site Web.
• Méfiez-vous des méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne menons pas d'entretiens via WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toutes les communications se font via les e-mails et les plateformes officielles de l'entreprise.
• Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toutes les communications de notre part proviendront d'e-mails se terminant par @ tether.to ou @ tether.io
• Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si quelqu’un demande des informations financières personnelles ou un paiement à tout moment du processus d’embauche, il s’agit d’une arnaque. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement. En cas de doute, n'hésitez pas à nous contacter via notre site officiel.

jobs.title: Influencer Marketing Manager (100% Remote)
jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 We're hiring an Influencer Marketing Manager to build and run Tether's influencer program .
 This isn't a typical influencer role. Half the work is the usual: identifying creators, building relationships, running campaigns, measuring impact, and creating affinity for Tether and our products. The other half is harder — we need someone who can credibly engage tech and developer influencers , because the developer audience is one of Tether's most important constituencies and it doesn't respond to standard marketing playbooks.

Responsibilities

• Build and own Tether's global influencer strategy across AI, tech, lifestyle, culture, health, crypto and more.

• Identify, vet, and build long-term relationships with influencers and creators solo and via agencies where it makes sense.

• Run end-to-end campaigns: brief, contract, ship, measure, iterate

• Partner with product teams across all four pillars (Stable Finance, Stable Intelligence, Stable Power, Stable Communications) to align influencer activity with what we're actually launching

• Develop the tech and developer influencer programme specifically YouTubers, technical bloggers, OSS maintainers, tech podcast hosts, AI influencers,

• Stay close to platform shifts like X, Rumble, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitch,, and whatever comes next

• 5+ years in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, or comparable creator-side experience

• A real track record of campaigns you've run end-to-end, with results you can talk about

• Grow genuine familiarity with the tech and developer creator ecosystem — not just consumer-lifestyle

• Working knowledge of crypto, AI, or P2P/open-source enough to brief a creator without embarrassing yourself

• Sharp instincts for which creators are authentic and which aren't

Bonus points

• Existing relationships with developer influencers or technical content creators

• You've built an influencer program from scratch before

• You've worked with agencies in multiple regions and know how to manage them

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

 At Tether, we're building the infrastructure powering the next generation of financial products, tokenized assets, and digital currencies at global scale.

Platform Scalability & Reliability

Core Skills

• Experience with databases, asynchronous systems, and microservices architectures

• Familiarity with blockchain infrastructure and digital asset ecosystems

• Strong debugging and problem-solving skills

• Experience working in fast-paced engineering environments

• Familiarity with Ethereum and EVM-compatible ecosystems

About the job
 Senior Business Analysts specializing in the mining sector to support M&A advisory and investment banking activities focused on mining-related opportunities. The role bridges technical geological expertise with commercial and financial analysis, evaluating mining assets, transactions, and investment opportunities across the resources value chain.

Responsibilities

• Conduct due diligence on mining assets and companies, integrating geological, technical, and commercial assessments.

• Build and maintain financial models (DCF, NAV, comparable transactions and companies) for mining projects and corporate transactions.

• Analyze mineral resource and reserve statements (JORC, NI 43-101, or equivalent) and assess their commercial implications.

• Evaluate mining project economics, including capex/opex profiles, production schedules, commodity price assumptions, and risk factors.

• Prepare investment memoranda, pitch books, valuation summaries, and board-level presentations.

• Monitor commodity markets, mining sector trends, M&A activity, and the competitive landscape.

• Support deal execution, including coordination with technical consultants, legal teams, and counterparties.

• Assess geopolitical, permitting, environmental, and ESG risks affecting mining investments.

• Structure and evaluate alternative and structured financing schemes for mining operations, including metal prepays, royalties, streaming agreements, offtake and marketing arrangements, and debt/equity hybrids, and assess their impact on project economics and counterparty risk.

Requirements

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geology, Geological Engineering, Mining Engineering, or Earth Sciences.

• 5+ years of relevant experience in mining, investment banking, corporate finance, equity research, or technical/financial advisory within the resources sector.

• Exposure to M&A transactions, project finance, or asset valuation in mining is highly desirable.

• Formal business education or training is a plus (MBA, finance/business degree, CFA progress, or equivalent practical commercial experience).

• Demonstrated understanding of mineral resource classification codes (JORC, NI 43-101, SAMREC, or similar).

• Working knowledge of structured financing instruments used in the mining sector, including prepays, royalties, streams, and offtake agreements.

• Strong financial modelling and valuation skills.

• Ability to translate technical geological data into commercial and financial insight.

• Advanced proficiency in Excel; familiarity with mining technical software (e.g., resource and mine-planning tools) is an advantage.

• Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving abilities.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, including report and presentation preparation.

• Ability to manage multiple workstreams under deadline pressure.

• Attention to detail and sound commercial judgement.

Preferred / Advantageous

• Experience across multiple commodities (e.g., base metals, precious metals, bulk commodities, battery metals).

jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 We need someone who is equally comfortable writing C and JavaScript. The Bare team builds and maintains the runtime itself along with a growing ecosystem of native modules (bare-bluetooth, bare-tcp, bare-fs, bare-crypto, and many more). You would be writing native addons that bridge platform APIs into JavaScript, debugging across multiple operating systems, and helping keep the runtime small and correct. This is a hands-on systems role. You will work independently, own modules end to end, and ship code that runs on phones, laptops, servers, and constrained devices.

Native module development

• Design, implement, and ship bare-* native modules (e.g., bare-bluetooth, bare-tcp, bare-fs, bare-crypto) end to end, including code, and tests

• Write C native addons that bridge platform APIs (Bluetooth, networking, filesystem, crypto) into JavaScript

• Maintain and extend existing native modules based on product team requests and the bare-node compatibility list

Cross-platform builds and CI

• Set up and maintain cross-platform builds for macOS, Linux, Android (NDK), and iOS (Xcode)

• Own cross-compilation toolchain configuration for each target platform

• Maintain CI pipelines that build and test native modules across all supported platforms

• Investigate and fix platform-specific build failures and toolchain issues

Bare Runtime contributions

• Contribute to the Bare runtime core (module system, native addon system, light-weight threads)

• Help reduce the bare-node missing API surface

• Participate in evaluating and integrating alternative JS engines eg libjerry

Debugging and quality

• Debug native addon issues across multiple OS and device targets, including mobile

• Write and maintain tests for all modules

Collaboration and communication

• Respond to Bare team inquiries from internal teams and the public.

• Communicate progress, blockers, and decisions in writing .

• Participate in a weekly status call.

• Participate in Bare workshops and contribute to onboarding materials.

• Coordinate with product teams (Keet, WDK/Wallet).

• Strong C programming skills, including experience writing and debugging native code across platforms.

• Advanced JavaScript skills with a solid understanding of Node.js internals and the module ecosystem.

• Experience building native addons for Node.js or similar runtimes (N-API, node-gyp, or equivalent).

• Familiarity with libuv or other asynchronous I/O frameworks.

• Comfortable working across macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS build toolchains.

• Experience with cross-compilation and platform-specific system APIs (Bluetooth, networking, filesystem).

• Ability to read and navigate large C and C++ codebases.

• Self-directed work style with strong written communication skills.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
 As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in architecture development for cutting-edge models of various scales, including small, large, and multi-modal systems. Your work will enhance intelligence, improve efficiency, and introduce new capabilities to advance the field.
 You will have a deep expertise in Large Language Model (LLM) and Multi-Modal architectures, a strong grasp of pre-training optimization, and a hands-on, research-driven approach. Your mission is to explore and implement novel techniques and algorithms that lead to groundbreaking advancements: multi-modal data curation and alignment, strengthening baselines, and identifying and resolving existing pre-training bottlenecks to push the limits of cross-modal AI performance.

Responsibilities

• Large-Scale Pre-Training: Conduct foundational pre-training for LLMs and Multi-Modal models (integrating text, vision, audio, or other modalities) on large, distributed servers equipped with multi-nodes & thousands of NVIDIA GPUs.

• Architecture & Alignment Innovation: Design, prototype, and scale innovative architectures, tokenizers, and cross-modal alignment layers to enhance model intelligence and multi-modal understanding.

• Data Strategy: Source, filter, and curate massive-scale textual and multi-modal datasets, establishing robust data pipelines for efficient pre-training.

• Experimental Research: Independently and collaboratively execute experiments, analyze results, and refine training methodologies for optimal performance and token efficiency.

• Optimization & Debugging: Investigate, debug, and eliminate bottlenecks in model efficiency, computational performance, and multi-modal alignment stability during long training runs.

• System Scalability: Contribute to the advancement of distributed training systems to ensure seamless scalability and hardware efficiency on target platforms.

• A degree in Computer Science or related field. Ideally PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D (with good publications in A* conferences).

• Hands-on experience contributing to large-scale LLM or Multi-Modal pre-training runs on large, distributed servers equipped with thousands of NVIDIA GPUs, ensuring scalability and impactful advancements in model performance.

• Familiarity and practical experience with large-scale, distributed training frameworks, libraries and tools.

• Deep knowledge of state-of-the-art transformer and non-transformer modifications aimed at enhancing intelligence, efficiency and scalability.

• Strong expertise in PyTorch and Hugging Face libraries with practical experience in model development, continual pretraining, and deployment.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
